jobs.title: Sr Director, Payments Engineering
jobs.description:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to lead the teams building and operating our payments platform. You'll shape technical strategy, strengthen engineering execution, and develop an organization that delivers reliable, scalable payment experiences.

This role requires a leader who combines technical depth with strong organizational leadership: someone who raises the bar for system performance, software quality, and operational discipline while helping teams move faster through effective use of AI tooling. Payment experience is a plus.

In This Role, You'll

Lead for performance, scale, and resilience. Define the architecture and technical roadmap for a payments platform that supports growing transaction volumes, delivers low latency, and remains reliable through traffic spikes and downstream failures.
Raise engineering and operational standards. Establish strong practices for system design, code quality, testing, observability, incident response, and continuous improvement. Build consistent approaches to integrating and operating across multiple payment gateways, including failure isolation, safe retries, and recovery.
Improve engineering productivity with AI. Accelerate the adoption of AI tools across development, testing, code review, and troubleshooting. Measure their impact on delivery speed and quality, and establish practices that preserve security and maintainability.
Partner across the business. Work closely with Product, Cloud Engineering, Security and gateway partners to deliver the business outcomes.

About You

You bring:

Experience leading multiple engineering teams and managers, with responsibility for technical strategy, organizational health, and execution.
A track record of building and operating high-throughput, highly available distributed systems, with demonstrated improvements in performance, scalability, and resilience.
Strong technical judgment and the ability to engage deeply in architecture, design, and code quality while empowering teams to make decisions.
Experience establishing engineering and operational excellence across complex systems and third-party integrations, including clear service objectives, effective incident management, and measurable reliability improvements.
Practical experience improving engineering productivity through AI tooling with an emphasis on measurable outcomes.
Demonstrated success recruiting, retaining, and developing engineers and managers, setting ambitious but achievable goals, and addressing performance gaps directly and constructively.
Strong communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and connect engineering decisions to business priorities.

Preferred Experience

Payments experience spanning gateways, processors, orchestration, authorization, settlement, reconciliation, or payment risk.
Familiarity with financial transaction correctness, idempotency, payment security, and PCI compliance.

Deep payments expertise is welcome, but not required. We value leaders who have built reliable systems, developed strong teams, and can learn a complex domain quickly.

About The Team

You'll lead multiple engineering teams and managers responsible for the full lifecycle of our payments platform—from system architecture and gateway integration to operational reliability and continuous improvement. The organization combines deep technical expertise with strong execution discipline. Success in this role means building leadership capacity across the team, translating business priorities into measurable engineering outcomes, and establishing clear ownership and accountability for delivery, quality, and reliability. You'll work in close partnership with Product, Cloud Engineering, and Security to ensure the platform meets business needs while maintaining the highest standards for performance, availability, and security.

Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:

Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
Medical, dental, and vision insurance
Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
Mental wellbeing resources and support
Benefits may vary by location; details will be shared during the interview process

#ZEOLife at Zuora

ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:

Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
Learn constantly and iterate often
Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

Think, be and do you.

At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com
(or local equivalent, where applicable).

While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering and Analytics
jobs.description:
Job Description

We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. Join our company and be part of a team that uses the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.

Within Small Molecule Science & Technology (SM S&T), we are advancing digital and data capabilities that strengthen technical operations, accelerate insight generation, and improve business outcomes across the product lifecycle. The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics is a newly created and exciting role, and we are looking for a data-minded engineer to join Small Molecule Science and Technology (SMS&T) to lead and build a data engineering and analytics team across Technical Operations.

The Director of Data Engineering and Analytics, reporting to the Executive Director or End to End Technical Leadership Organization, will serve as the technical leader responsible for translating Small Molecule Science & Technology's (SM S&T) data and analytics priorities into execution, adoption, and business value. This role requires who can drive accountability and execution across a highly matrixed organization across SM S&T, Digital Manufacturing Division, Digital CMC, MPI, IT and Global Pharmaceutical Operations to accelerate the deployment, implementation and standardization of digital strategy tools to advance analytics and data engineering capabilities, deliver sustained adoption and measurable business impact.

The Director is expected to bring a strong understating of digital systems and tools, data science and analytics operating effectively at the intersection of business, science, manufacturing, engineering, and digital technology. The role requires a strong technical understanding of unit operations across Small Molecule Drug Substance, Drug Product, Packaging, and Analytical Sciences to maximize value add to the pipeline and inline portfolio.

Responsibilities

Drive execution of agreed-upon data and analytics priorities across Small Molecule Science & Technology (SM S&T), ensuring progress and measurable business impact.
Translate data and analytics strategy into practical implementation plans, clear milestones, and value realization metrics.
Partner with SM S&T leadership, Digital Manufacturing Division, Digital CMC, MPI, IT, and site teams to align priorities and remove barriers to execution.
Ensure analytics initiatives are anchored in clear business problems and deliver practical value to the organization.
Serve as a credible translator between technical SMEs, manufacturing teams, and data/IT partners.
Convert complex business and manufacturing needs into practical analytical requirements and scalable solution designs.
Influence the data and analytics strategy across partner organizations where alignment is required.
Advance the democratization and engineering of data across SM S&T by improving the access, contextualization, and usability of manufacturing and process data.
Lead data engineering initiatives to build robust data pipelines, ensuring data quality and accessibility from source systems to analytical platforms.
Enable scientists and engineers to directly access and use data to support process monitoring, investigations, and lifecycle management.
Drive adoption of capabilities that support Proactive Process Monitoring, Continuous Process Verification, Manufacturing Process Intelligence (MPI), and data-driven decision-making.
Lead the implementation and adoption of data and analytics solutions across SM S&T.
Apply a strong technical understanding of unit operations across Drug Substance, Drug Product, Packaging, and analytical to ensure analytical tools are effectively utilized across the portfolio.
Establish and strengthen user communities to scale adoption beyond centralized expertise.
Represent SM S&T business priorities in data governance, portfolio, and demand management forums.
Partner with leadership to define the highest-value use cases and ensure resources are focused on impactful priorities.
Track progress against priorities and hold teams accountable for delivery, adoption, and value realization.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor of Science (BS) in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Data Science, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline with ten (10) years of required experience. (MS with 8)
Demonstrated leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing, technical operations, data engineering, or data science, with a proven track record of driving data-driven transformation in a regulated environment.
Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including a strong technical understanding of unit operations across Drug Substance, Drug Product, packaging, and analytical.
Expertise in manufacturing data systems, process monitoring, and data and analytics technologies supporting technical operations.
Proven ability to influence across matrix organizations and drive accountability for execution and results.
Travel to Manufacturing site will be required, estimated at

Preferred

Advanced degree (MS, MBA, PharmD, or PhD).
Experience with manufacturing data and analytics platforms such as DataLynx, SEEQ, MPI, MES, historians, or similar technologies.

Required Skills

Advanced Analytics, Advanced Analytics, Business Alignment, Business Intelligence (BI), Database Administration, Data Engineering, Data Integrity, Data Management, Data Modeling, Data Visualization, Design Applications, Digital Transformation, Executive Leadership, Implementation Methodologies, Information Management, Metrics Development, Process Alignment, Process Definition, Progress Monitoring, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solution Architecture, Strategic Alignment, Strategy Deployment, System Designs {+ 1 more}

jobs.title: Director, Client Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

The Client Platform team, part of Business Technology (BT) at Workday, is responsible for managing, securing, and optimizing every end-user device across our global workforce. We build the digital foundation that enables employees to work securely and seamlessly from anywhere. Managing a hybrid ecosystem of macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android devices, our team sits at the vital intersection of endpoint management, enterprise security, and employee experience.

About The Role

We are looking for a dynamic, high-ownership Director of Client Platforms to lead our global endpoint engineering and management organization. Operating with a high sense of urgency, you will drive the strategy, lifecycle, and security posture for thousands of endpoints. You are a decisive leader who excels at cross-functional partnership - working hand-in-hand with Information Security to enforce zero-trust policies, maintain patching cadences, and leverage AI to automate device provisioning, L2 ticket resolution, and fleet compliance.

Responsibilities

Strategic Fleet Management: Define and execute the global hardware, OS, and endpoint management strategy across Apple (macOS/iOS) and PC/Android ecosystems to ensure a premium employee experience without compromising security.
Security & Vulnerability Partnership: Work in lockstep with the Information Security team to establish, measure, and enforce robust endpoint security baselines, zero-trust access controls, disk encryption, and rapid patching/vulnerability remediation.
AI & Operational Automation: Leverage AI capabilities and automated workflows to accelerate device onboarding/offboarding, streamline configuration enforcement, and drive intelligent ticket deflection for endpoint-related L2/L3 issues.
Global Team Leadership: Direct, develop, and scale a high-performing team of endpoint engineers, architects, and platform leads operating across time zones.
Tooling Architecture & Optimization: Own and optimize our core platform stack, including Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, and zero-touch deployment pipelines (Apple Business Manager, Autopilot).
Vendor & Lifecycle Management: Drive global hardware procurement strategies, manage OEM relationships (Apple, Dell, Lenovo), oversee hardware refresh cycles, and manage software licensing costs to maximize ROI.

About You

Obsessed with Execution: You possess a relentless drive and bias for action. When vulnerability disclosures occur, you act with high urgency to ensure quick compliance and fleet-wide protection.
Collaborative Partner: You view Security as a core partner. You know how to balance rigorous security compliance with a smooth user experience. You build strong relationships across other BT functions and business organizations.
Forward-Thinking Innovator: You stay ahead of modern device management trends and actively use AI and scripting automation to remove operational friction and human error.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of enterprise IT leadership experience, with at least 4+ years leading global teams focused on client platform engineering, endpoint management, or desktop infrastructure.
4+ years of experience managing diverse fleet architectures at scale (25,000+ endpoints across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android).
5+ years of experience with enterprise MDM/UEM platforms, specifically Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune.

Other Qualifications

Demonstrated track record of partnering with Security teams to meet SLAs on OS/application patching, EDR deployments, and compliance reporting.
AI domain fluency, including a practical understanding of modern AI capabilities, limitations, governance considerations, and responsible enterprise application.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar IT software budgets and leading complex enterprise vendor negotiations.
Experience operating within high-growth Bay Area technology companies.
Expertise in zero-touch deployment models (Apple Business Manager/DEP, Windows Autopilot) and identity integrations (Okta, Entra ID).
Strong familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) and EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne).

As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). jobs.description:
At Alaska Communications, we’re committed to putting our team first
, always being customer focused
, having a can-do attitude
, owning our results
and always acting with integrity
. This is what we hire for and what our team members exhibit each day. Want to make an impact with us?

We are unable to support remote international applicants or routinely sponsor work visas.

The Compensation Range For This Job Is

$161,475.00 - $215,299.00

Position Summary

Directs and manages the teams and programs responsible for planning, engineering, design, records accuracy, and lifecycle stewardship of network infrastructure supporting the ACS network. This role has complete ownership and accountability for Layer 1 infrastructure planning and design, including outside plant facilities, inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, fiber routes, ducts, conduits, structures, DC power capacity, rack location and availability, capacity, records, and related construction engineering. The role is also accountable for coordinating end-to-end network infrastructure plans across Layer 2 and Layer 3 domains, in partnership with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and the Network Architects, to ensure physical infrastructure, transport, aggregation, routing, resiliency, and growth plans are aligned to business, customer, operational, and capital priorities.

The Senior Director, Network Infrastructure & Planning translates business demand, network strategy, service delivery requirements, reliability objectives, and funded project commitments into actionable infrastructure plans, budget inputs, engineering priorities, and implementation readiness. The position emphasizes accountable ownership of Layer 1 outcomes while providing shared planning accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network evolution.

Essential Functions

Essential Functions Statement(s)

Owns end-to-end planning and design accountability for Layer 1 network infrastructure, including OSP fiber, copper where applicable, ducts, conduits, poles, handholes, manholes, facility routes, splice plans, capacity, and physical network records.
Owns planning and availability accountability for inside plant infrastructure associated with the network, including DC power capacity, rack location, rack availability, physical space readiness, and related facility dependencies needed to support network growth, resiliency, and implementation readiness.
Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure plans support network reliability, route diversity, resiliency, serviceability, maintainability, constructability, permitting readiness, and economic utilization of facilities.
Oversees analysis of available and existing facilities, route constraints, capacity exhaust, customer demand, traffic growth indicators, and funded project requirements to determine new construction, rearrangements, removals, or augmentation needs.
Develops, maintains, and improves sustainable facilities records processes with the goal of complete, accurate, timely, and electronically accessible network records.
Provides shared accountability for Layer 2 and Layer 3 network planning with the Sr. Director of IP Engineering and network architects, ensuring Layer 1 infrastructure plans are coordinated with transport, aggregation, routing, peering, resiliency, and capacity strategies.
Partners with IP Engineering leadership and architects to translate strategic network architecture into practical infrastructure needs, including site readiness, fiber availability, route diversity, physical path constraints, equipment location requirements, and capital planning inputs.
Facilitates decision-making and escalation when Layer 1 infrastructure constraints affect Layer 2 or Layer 3 design alternatives, schedule, budget, resiliency, or service delivery commitments.
Develops budgetary inputs, capital forecasts, and business case support for approved and proposed network infrastructure projects.

Position Qualifications

Competency Statement(s)

Leadership – Ability to influence others to perform their jobs effectively and to be responsible for making decisions.
Accountability - Ability to plan, organize, measure, and coordinate multiple tasks to deliver the budget for product line, revenue, and profit.
Adaptability - Ability to adapt to change in the workplace.
Analytical Skills - Ability to use thinking and reasoning to solve a problem.
Creative - Ability to think in such a way as to produce a new concept or idea.
Detail Oriented - Ability to pay attention to the minute details of a project or task.
Judgment - The ability to formulate a sound decision using the available information.
Problem Solving - Ability to find a solution for or to deal proactively with work-related problems.
Responsible - Ability to be held accountable or answerable for one’s conduct.
Technical Aptitude - Ability to comprehend complex technical topics and specialized information.
Time Management - Ability to utilize the available time to organize and complete work within given deadlines.

Skills & Abilities

Education:
Bachelor’s Degree in related fields, such as Engineering, Business or Construction. Equivalent experience may be substituted for schooling on a year-for-year basis.

Experience:
Twelve (12) years of telecommunications engineering/construction experience. Equivalent education may be substituted for years of experience.

Computer Skills:
Demonstrated proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite, to include Word, Excel, Outlook, and Access. Demonstrated proficiency using OSP Insight and AutoCAD.

jobs.title: Sr Manager Software Dev, Advertising Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence
jobs.description:
Description

Senior Software Development Manager, FAIM Evaluations.

Amazon Advertising is building toward a future where an advertiser specifies a few marketing parameters (budget, success definition, which products to promote) and a set of AI agents handles the rest. The Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models (FAIM) organization owns that bet: the Ads Nova agent, the Ads Nova model it reasons with, and the agent infrastructure, learning environments, and evaluations that connect the two. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to found and lead the FAIM Evaluations team. You will report directly to the Vice President of Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models and own how the entire organization answers one question: is this actually good at advertising?

This is a ground-up build. Evaluation today lives inside individual model and agent teams, measured task by task. You will create the standalone engineering team that turns it into a shared, rigorous system spanning the Ads Nova model, the Ads Nova agent, and the internal agent that serves our Sales, Services, and Operations teams. No inherited harness, no pattern to follow, and a direct line to the VP who sponsors the work.

What we're building

An advertising benchmark: a representative set of real advertising tasks, organized by domain and difficulty, from single-step questions through multi-step analysis to long-horizon strategic work, each with structured criteria for what a correct end-to-end response looks like

Evaluation infrastructure that scores models and agents deterministically against that benchmark, compares Ads Nova to frontier models on the tasks that matter to advertisers, and gives every science and product team in FAIM the same yardstick

Rubrics and task environments built to serve double duty: scoring quality today and producing the reward signal that trains the next version of the model

An expert-in-the-loop program that captures how experienced advertising practitioners actually work and encodes that judgment into criteria a machine can grade against

A capability map, derived from benchmark results, that tells FAIM where the model and agent stand and what to train next

Key job responsibilities

Found and lead a standalone team of roughly 10-12: software engineers plus a product manager and a technical program manager; you will hire most of them

Own the technical vision and roadmap for FAIM evaluations end to end: task taxonomy, rubric design, environment construction, scoring, benchmark versioning, and the separation between what we evaluate on and what we train on

Build for the whole org, not one product: your team evaluates the Ads Nova model, the Ads Nova agent, and the internal agent, and you participate in the planning and reviews for all three

Partner with applied scientists across FAIM to turn evaluation criteria into training signal for reinforcement learning, and to make sure what we measure is what we optimize

Run the domain-expert program: source advertising practitioners, define the annotation and calibration process, and hold the quality bar on inter-rater agreement

Set the evaluation standard for the organization and hold the line on it; where good internal assets already exist, adopt them rather than rebuild

Publish results leadership and partner teams trust, and own the cadence for re-scoring as models, agents, and tasks evolve

Represent evaluations in VP-level reviews, annual planning, and cross-org discussions on model and agent quality

We're looking for a leader who brings

10+ years of engineering experience and 5+ years managing engineering teams, including building a team from a small core

A track record delivering evaluation systems, benchmarks, or data-quality programs for machine learning models, ideally large language models or agentic systems

Working fluency in how modern models are trained and improved (supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from rubric or verifier signal) and what makes an eval useful as a training asset rather than only a scorecard

Judgment about measurement: when all-or-nothing grading beats partial credit, how to find ambiguous criteria through grader disagreement

Experience running expert-annotation or labeling programs with external partners, including quality control at scale

The ability to operate in ambiguity: turn "is it good at advertising" into a concrete, scored, versioned asset with minimal scoping help

Comfort working as the engineering counterpart to scientists you do not manage, and the influence to get model, agent, and product teams onto one yardstick

Advertising domain knowledge, or the curiosity and speed to build it by working closely with practitioners

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, agent frameworks, and tool-use protocols (MCP) is a plus

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of engineering experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment
10+ years of software development experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related technical field
Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
Experience with software development in a team, and a track record of shipping software on time

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with product and program management teams
Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications
Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams
Experience with AI/ML technologies
Experience within advertising technology related sales
Experience with AWS Services including EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Slack is looking for an Engineering Manager on the Core Services engineering team. The purpose of this role is to keep Slack working seamlessly at massive scale — it's the infrastructure that keeps Slack feeling lightning fast. This person will be a steward of some of the most critical, high-throughput systems at Slack — the kind of work where doing it well means millions of users, at the world’s most important and interesting companies, never experience a hiccup.

About The Opportunity

We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that include:

Edge Caches
Realtime Services
Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
International Data Residency (IDR)
Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).

We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.

We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If

You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If

You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.
You've led teams through system deprecation and migration while maintaining service reliability.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, OLO
jobs.description:
About Owner

Owner is the AI-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants.

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.

Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.

Our vision

We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.

But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.

Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.

In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.

Our traction

Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website.

More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees.

Our team

Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

Where we work

Owner is a remote-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location!

Role Overview

Owner's promise to a restaurant isn't software, it's revenue. When a guest lands on a restaurant's site, we want them to find what they're craving, trust what they see, and check out without friction, whether or not the owner ever touches a setting.

As we scale, we're expanding our product engineering leadership to ship faster, raise the bar on the guest ordering experience, and build the systems that make it work across thousands of restaurants. As the Engineering Manager for OLO, you'll lead a team of full-stack engineers building the guest web ordering experience, from menu, cart and checkout to promotions, photos, and the menu quality systems that make about 10,000 merchant-written menus convert like they were designed by a pro. Next, we're taking OLO to enterprise and multi-location brands, and pushing guest conversion toward 10% through disciplined experimentation. This role is equal parts product intuition and technical execution. You'll be trusted to make hard prioritization calls, ship experiments that move revenue, and grow a team that embodies engineering excellence.

We move with urgency, bias toward simplicity, and expect our leaders to be hands-on when needed. If you're energized by ownership, measurable impact, and solving real problems for small business owners, we'd love to hear from you.

Why we’re looking for you

Owner's promise to a restaurant isn't software — it's revenue. OLO is where that promise gets converted: the guest web ordering experience (menu, cart, checkout, promotions) plus the automated systems that find and fix menu quality problems across roughly 10,000 menus written by merchants we don't control.

We treat conversion as an automated system, not a design review. We build rubrics, detection, and remediation, then prove every change with an experiment. Next, we're taking OLO upmarket to enterprise and multi-location brands and pushing conversion toward 10%.

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the team through that, keep it healthy, and hold a high bar on what we ship and what we cut.

This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

Our Stack

Web / Growth: React, Next.js, TypeScript — guest web ordering, menu quality, experimentation platform
Backend & Services: Node.js, MongoDB → PostgreSQL (migration in flight), Temporal, Datadog
Language: TypeScript everywhere

The Impact You'll Have

Build the experimentation engine that pushes guest conversion toward 10%, across checkout, fulfillment, merchandising, and promotions
Take OLO to enterprise and multi-location brands, with the reliability and menu complexity they need
Get >90% of menus, including POS-integrated ones, to our menu quality bar, and build the system that keeps live menus optimized as they change
Scale photo coverage using guest sourcing, auto-replating, licensed catalogs, and generated combo images, each tied to measured GPV lift
Rebuild promotions from the ground up: redemption UX, badges, auto-apply, and merchandising
Cut fulfillment selection errors and finish the Postgres migration

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of engineering management, leading teams of 6–10+ engineers on customer-facing product
Track record of running growth or conversion programs: metrics, A/B testing at scale, funnel analysis
Experience scaling a product for enterprise or multi-location customers
Strong prioritization: you can take a roadmap bigger than your team and make hard, clear calls
Technical credibility in full-stack web (React/TypeScript, Node.js) and data-heavy systems
Cares about team health and has led people through heavy or repetitive workloads
Excellent cross-functional partner to PM, design, and adjacent teams

Compensation And Benefits

The estimated base salary range for this role is $250K-$270K, depending on experience and location. The offer also includes a a generous pre-IPO equity package.
Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, remote-first workplace, unlimited PTO - plus extra fun perks!

Notice - Employment Scams

Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address.

We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Prototyping AI and Customer Engineering, AWS Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering (PACE)
jobs.description:
Description

AWS Prototyping and AI Customer Engineering (PACE) is the team customers work with when they need to move from idea to production on their most complex AI and cloud challenges. We build working prototypes, run executive briefings, and deliver guided builds that compress months of development into days. Our work directly influences customer commitment decisions spanning generative AI, agentic architectures, computer vision, and full-stack cloud modernization. PACE operates globally with teams aligned to industry verticals in each geo, ensuring deep customer proximity and field stakeholder partnership.

We are looking for a Sr. Manager, Solutions Architecture to lead one of the PACE North America delivery teams, aligned to Financial Services (FSI), Retail & (CPG), and Canada (inclusive of all industries). You will own integrated PODs, each paired with a technical program manager and dedicated prototyping architects, and you will be responsible for the quality, velocity, and business impact of every engagement your team delivers. You will manage approximately 10 to 12 people directly.

You will develop deep relationships with field stakeholders (Sales Directors, Solutions Architecture Leaders, CSM Leaders) across FSI, Retail and CPG, and Canada. You will own the delivery side of those partnerships and drive operational rigor: capacity planning, engagement intake prioritization, prototype quality standards, and the mechanisms that connect prototyping work to launched revenue. jobs.description:

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Slack is looking for an Engineering Manager on the Core Services engineering team. The purpose of this role is to keep Slack working seamlessly at massive scale — it's the infrastructure that keeps Slack feeling lightning fast. This person will be a steward of some of the most critical, high-throughput systems at Slack — the kind of work where doing it well means millions of users, at the world’s most important and interesting companies, never experience a hiccup.

About The Opportunity

We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that include:

Edge Caches
Realtime Services
Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
International Data Residency (IDR)
Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).

We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.

We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If

You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If

You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.
You've led teams through system deprecation and migration while maintaining service reliability.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

jobs.title: Sr Manager Software Dev, Advertising Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence
jobs.description:
Description

Senior Software Development Manager, FAIM Evaluations.

Amazon Advertising is building toward a future where an advertiser specifies a few marketing parameters (budget, success definition, which products to promote) and a set of AI agents handles the rest. The Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models (FAIM) organization owns that bet: the Ads Nova agent, the Ads Nova model it reasons with, and the agent infrastructure, learning environments, and evaluations that connect the two. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Manager to found and lead the FAIM Evaluations team. You will report directly to the Vice President of Full Funnel Agentic Intelligence and Models and own how the entire organization answers one question: is this actually good at advertising?

This is a ground-up build. Evaluation today lives inside individual model and agent teams, measured task by task. You will create the standalone engineering team that turns it into a shared, rigorous system spanning the Ads Nova model, the Ads Nova agent, and the internal agent that serves our Sales, Services, and Operations teams. No inherited harness, no pattern to follow, and a direct line to the VP who sponsors the work.

What we're building

An advertising benchmark: a representative set of real advertising tasks, organized by domain and difficulty, from single-step questions through multi-step analysis to long-horizon strategic work, each with structured criteria for what a correct end-to-end response looks like

Evaluation infrastructure that scores models and agents deterministically against that benchmark, compares Ads Nova to frontier models on the tasks that matter to advertisers, and gives every science and product team in FAIM the same yardstick

Rubrics and task environments built to serve double duty: scoring quality today and producing the reward signal that trains the next version of the model

An expert-in-the-loop program that captures how experienced advertising practitioners actually work and encodes that judgment into criteria a machine can grade against

A capability map, derived from benchmark results, that tells FAIM where the model and agent stand and what to train next

Key job responsibilities

Found and lead a standalone team of roughly 10-12: software engineers plus a product manager and a technical program manager; you will hire most of them

Own the technical vision and roadmap for FAIM evaluations end to end: task taxonomy, rubric design, environment construction, scoring, benchmark versioning, and the separation between what we evaluate on and what we train on

Build for the whole org, not one product: your team evaluates the Ads Nova model, the Ads Nova agent, and the internal agent, and you participate in the planning and reviews for all three

Partner with applied scientists across FAIM to turn evaluation criteria into training signal for reinforcement learning, and to make sure what we measure is what we optimize

Run the domain-expert program: source advertising practitioners, define the annotation and calibration process, and hold the quality bar on inter-rater agreement

Set the evaluation standard for the organization and hold the line on it; where good internal assets already exist, adopt them rather than rebuild

Publish results leadership and partner teams trust, and own the cadence for re-scoring as models, agents, and tasks evolve

Represent evaluations in VP-level reviews, annual planning, and cross-org discussions on model and agent quality

We're looking for a leader who brings

10+ years of engineering experience and 5+ years managing engineering teams, including building a team from a small core

A track record delivering evaluation systems, benchmarks, or data-quality programs for machine learning models, ideally large language models or agentic systems

Working fluency in how modern models are trained and improved (supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning from rubric or verifier signal) and what makes an eval useful as a training asset rather than only a scorecard

Judgment about measurement: when all-or-nothing grading beats partial credit, how to find ambiguous criteria through grader disagreement

Experience running expert-annotation or labeling programs with external partners, including quality control at scale

The ability to operate in ambiguity: turn "is it good at advertising" into a concrete, scored, versioned asset with minimal scoping help

Comfort working as the engineering counterpart to scientists you do not manage, and the influence to get model, agent, and product teams onto one yardstick

Advertising domain knowledge, or the curiosity and speed to build it by working closely with practitioners

Experience with Amazon Bedrock, agent frameworks, and tool-use protocols (MCP) is a plus

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of engineering experience
5+ years of engineering team management experience
10+ years of planning, designing, developing and delivering consumer software experience
Experience partnering with product or program management teams
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs, projects and development teams in an Agile environment
10+ years of software development experience
Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related technical field
Experience designing, building, operating, and managing large-scale distributed systems or web services
Experience with software development in a team, and a track record of shipping software on time

Preferred Qualifications

Experience partnering with product and program management teams
Experience designing and developing large scale, high-traffic applications
Experience hiring, developing, and managing high-performing technical teams
Experience with AI/ML technologies
Experience within advertising technology related sales
Experience with AWS Services including EC2, Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS

jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a senior engineering leader to define and scale our ATE development strategy for complex silicon products from new product introduction through high-volume manufacturing. This role leads a global organization responsible for production test architecture, hardware and program development, silicon correlation, quality screening, yield enablement, cost-of-test optimization, and test automation. The ideal candidate brings deep semiconductor test expertise, strong interpersonal leadership, and can drive execution across developing, product engineering, manufacturing, reliability, and supplier ecosystems.

What You Will Be Doing

Set the vision, roadmap, and operating model guiding ATE creation throughout new product introductions and sustaining production.
Lead and develop a distributed team composed of managers and senior engineers covering test hardware, program development, characterization, correlation, productization, and data-driven test optimization.
Drive production test readiness for complex devices, including test coverage, guardband strategy, yield learning, defect screening, quality containment, and test cost reduction.
Establish scalable methodologies, standards, release criteria, and quality gates for ATE development and deployment.
Partner closely with architecture, circuit build, test integration, product engineering, system test, reliability, silicon operations, manufacturing, and collaborators outside the company to ensure strong design-to-test alignment.
Lead the strategy for ATE platform selection, vendor engagement, capacity readiness, and capital planning needed to support product ramps.
Use data and analytics to improve silicon correlation, test limits, binning strategies, excursion response, and long-term product quality.
Build a high-performance leadership culture through strong hiring, interpersonal development, succession planning, and multi-functional influence.

What We Need To See

BS, MS, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
18+ years of relevant semiconductor experience, including 8 + years of management experience. Leading managers and distributed engineering organizations.
Deep expertise in ATE development for high-volume silicon, SoC, ASIC, or GPU-class products.
Shown success leading organizations through NPI, silicon bring-up, characterization, production ramp, yield improvement, and quality execution.
Strong understanding of ATE platforms, test hardware design, test program development, instrumentation, silicon correlation, statistical analysis, and production test methodologies.
Consistent track record to partner across design, DFT, product engineering, failure analysis, reliability, manufacturing, and supplier or OSAT ecosystems.
Experience owning roadmaps, budgets, staffing plans, and operational priorities for large-scale engineering organizations.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to influence senior collaborators and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Experience with GPU, AI, networking, or other high-performance compute products.
Track record of reducing test cost while improving outgoing quality and production scalability.
Strong background in test automation, data infrastructure, and improvement guided by data insights.
Experience building and scaling global test-development organizations across multiple sites and external partners.
Familiarity with system-level test, product binning, performance and power optimization, or silicon operations workflows.

The Senior Director, Agentic Engineering serves as the executive leader of Forge's agentic engineering organization and is accountable for the technical vision, engineering execution, and operational excellence behind Truist's enterprise AI agent ecosystem. This leader owns the engineering function responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform how teammates and clients interact with the Firm.

This is a highly technical player-coach leadership role that combines executive organizational leadership with deep hands-on engineering expertise. The Senior Director leads the engineering function, establishes technical direction, drives work planning and execution, and serves as the ultimate escalation point for architecture and engineering decisions across the agentic engineering portfolio.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience building large-scale software and AI systems, including expertise in Python, modern systems languages such as Go, agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, retrieval architectures, and enterprise AI platform engineering. This leader will be responsible for shipping production agentic systems, not simply defining roadmaps, ensuring all solutions meet Truist standards for security, scalability, resiliency, observability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

The Senior Director partners closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Risk, and executive leadership teams to translate business strategy into enterprise-scale AI capabilities while building and mentoring a world-class team of agentic engineers.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

Lead the Agentic Engineering function, providing executive leadership, organizational design, technical governance, delivery accountability, and talent leadership across all agentic engineering initiatives.
Own the technical direction for Forge agentic solutions, establishing architecture standards, engineering patterns, and development practices for enterprise AI agents and multi-agent systems.
Drive work planning, prioritization, execution management, and delivery outcomes across the agentic engineering organization, ensuring teams consistently deliver high-quality production systems aligned to business commitments.
Serve as the final engineering authority for architecture decisions, engineering standards, and critical code review escalations across the agentic engineering portfolio.
Design and govern enterprise patterns for agent orchestration, tool invocation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory management, prompt architecture, workflow automation, reasoning frameworks, evaluation pipelines, observability, and operational support.
Lead the engineering strategy for enterprise agent platforms including Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and other emerging agentic technologies required to support the Forge roadmap.
Partner with Product, Technology, Security, Risk, Architecture, and Data leaders to ensure AI solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
Build and mentor a high-performing engineering organization through hiring, performance management, succession planning, coaching, career development, and technical leadership.
Establish and enforce engineering excellence standards including software craftsmanship, testing strategies, release management, architecture review, secure development practices, operational readiness, and reliability engineering.
Drive engineering execution across complex cross-functional initiatives involving application engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, cyber security, and enterprise architecture teams.
Champion engineering rigor through measurable quality controls, system reliability objectives, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, models, and engineering approaches, identifying opportunities to accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and strengthen enterprise capabilities
Represent Agentic Engineering in executive governance forums, architecture review boards, risk committees, vendor engagements, regulatory discussions, and industry working groups.
Manage organizational budgets, vendor relationships, workforce planning, engineering tooling investments, and resource allocation to support strategic objectives.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and responsible AI development across the organization

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent education, training and work-related experience.
Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in technology operations.
Broad leadership and management experience leading complex technology operations teams.
Proven ability to manage complex operational initiatives across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading enterprise Agentic Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Applied AI, Intelligent Automation, or Emerging Technology organizations.
Deep expertise in multi-agent systems, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, reasoning architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory systems, agent evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Experience building production AI applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Agent Engine, or similar platforms.
Experience operating enterprise-scale AI platforms supporting thousands of users and mission-critical business processes.
Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI principles, AI security controls, and enterprise AI operating models.
Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders, and build a culture of technical excellence.
Experience delivering solutions across cloud-native ecosystems using Azure and modern DevOps, platform engineering, and software delivery practices.
Experience driving architecture modernization and transformation initiatives within large enterprises.
Experience in financial services, fintech, cybersecurity, or other heavily regulated industries.
Demonstrated participation in industry forums, technology communities, open-source initiatives, vendor partnerships, or executive technology councils.

jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Defense Systems Group (DSG) provides analysis-based decision support to senior leaders on space architectures, policy and strategy, technology development, warfighter capability enablers, systems integration, defense industrial base, and threat reduction to help shape existing and future space missions across the national security space (NSS) enterprise. DSG is unique at Aerospace as it not only directly supports major customers, including the U.S. Space Force, U.S. Space Command, Air Force Material Command, and senior leadership at the Pentagon, but also provides a broad range of technical support across the national space enterprise, maintaining vertical responsibilities with customers’ portfolios as well as horizontal, matrixed responsibilities across the corporation. Additionally, DSG provides deep technical expertise to the Space Force Space Systems Command (SSC) in the conception, design, acquisition, launch and operations of satellite, launch vehicle, ground control, and range systems.

The Special Programs Division supports a broad array of Combat Power missions covering the entire threat response chain which includes the multidomain effects needed for space superiority. These programs include major system acquisitions for multiple ground and space segments, future architecture definition at the data/software/hardware levels, and research and technology for continuous evolution of space warfighting capabilities. The Space-Based Interceptor (SBI) Program Office seeks to develop and deploy a proliferated constellation of space-based interceptors capable of boost-phase engagement of adversary missiles. The SBI interceptors will employ multiple common elements that integrate with a larger layered missile defense system.

We are looking for a Systems Director - Space-Based Interceptor Ground Segment Engineering
to lead the SBI Ground Segment team that directly advises the government SBI Program Office on the development of the space segment of this novel missile defense capability.

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Huntsville, AL.

What You’ll Be Doing

Building and leading a dynamic team that provides technical expertise to the government Space-Based Interceptor Program Office (SBI PO) ground segment
Exemplify Aerospace corporate values of objectivity and integrity when serving as a trusted agent to the Material Leader of the SBI ground segment and senior government customers
Enabling direct reports to lead efforts to bring impactful technical expertise to the government and industry from SMEs across the corporation
Collaborating effectively with the broader layered defense architecture team and external stakeholders
Establishing a collaborative work environment that fosters a culture of innovation within the team to facilitate novel acquisition approaches for rapid capability development
Defining the Space Segment’s objectives and communicating them to subordinates, management, and interfacing matrix organizations to ensure alignment, clarity, and coordinated efforts towards achieving strategic goals and successful program execution.

What You Need To Be Successful

Minimum Requirements for Systems Director – Engineering Program Management and Systems Engineering:

Bachelor's degree in a STEM field or equivalent technical area of study
12 or more years of relevant professional or educational experience
Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills for interactions at all levels of corporate and government leadership
Proven leadership ability to operate strategically, including leading teams contributing to strategic objectives
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across organizations and manage competing priorities
Track record of delivering results through effective delegation while holding oneself accountable for results
This position requires a current and active Top Secret/SCI security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these :

Demonstrated experience in space systems engineering, missile defense technologies, and/or satellite operations
Proven track record of creating and leading multidisciplinary teams in high-stakes environments
Demonstration of excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with government agencies, industry partners, and contractors are necessary for maintaining strong relationships and ensuring alignment among all parties
Demonstrates enterprise-level perspective with prior Program Office(s) and ETG experience
Knowledge of rigorous testing and evaluation processes, including on-orbit demonstrations and live-fire tests
Experience with novel approaches in rapid capability development and deployment
Demonstrated management skills including budgeting, staff development, and strategic planning
Knowledge of Aerospace practices and policies relevant to department leadership
