When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Defense Systems Group (DSG) provides analysis-based decision support to senior leaders on space architectures, policy and strategy, technology development, warfighter capability enablers, systems integration, defense industrial base, and threat reduction to help shape existing and future space missions across the national security space (NSS) enterprise. DSG is unique at Aerospace as it not only directly supports major customers, including the U.S. Space Force, U.S. Space Command, Air Force Material Command, and senior leadership at the Pentagon, but also provides a broad range of technical support across the national space enterprise, maintaining vertical responsibilities with customers’ portfolios as well as horizontal, matrixed responsibilities across the corporation. Additionally, DSG provides deep technical expertise to the Space Force Space Systems Command (SSC) in the conception, design, acquisition, launch and operations of satellite, launch vehicle, ground control, and range systems.

The Special Programs Division supports a broad array of Combat Power missions covering the entire threat response chain which includes the multidomain effects needed for space superiority. These programs include major system acquisitions for multiple ground and space segments, future architecture definition at the data/software/hardware levels, and research and technology for continuous evolution of space warfighting capabilities. The Space-Based Interceptor (SBI) Program Office seeks to develop and deploy a proliferated constellation of space-based interceptors capable of boost-phase engagement of adversary missiles. The SBI interceptors will employ multiple common elements that integrate with a larger layered missile defense system.

We are looking for a Systems Director - Space-Based Interceptor Space Segment Engineering
to lead the SBI Space Segment team that directly advises the government SBI Program Office on the development of the space segment of this novel missile defense capability.

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Huntsville, AL.

What You’ll Be Doing

Building and leading a dynamic team that provides technical expertise to the government Space-Based Interceptor Program Office (SBI PO) space segment
Exemplify Aerospace corporate values of objectivity and integrity when serving as a trusted agent to the Material Leader of the SBI space segment and senior government customers
Enabling direct reports to lead efforts to bring impactful technical expertise to the government and industry from SMEs across the corporation
Collaborating effectively with the broader layered defense architecture team and external stakeholders
Establishing a collaborative work environment that fosters a culture of innovation within the team to facilitate novel acquisition approaches for rapid capability development
Defining the Space Segment’s objectives and communicating them to subordinates, management, and interfacing matrix organizations to ensure alignment, clarity, and coordinated efforts towards achieving strategic goals and successful program execution.

What You Need To Be Successful

Minimum Requirements for Systems Director – Engineering Program Management and Systems Engineering:

How You Can Stand Out

jobs.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using AI at the core

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

Onit is seeking a Director of Cybersecurity Engineering & Operations to lead the technical cybersecurity function across our AI-driven legal operations SaaS platforms and corporate infrastructure. Reporting to the Vice President, Compliance and Security, this highly technical leader translates the organization's cybersecurity strategy into security architecture, engineering capabilities, and security operations that protect our products, cloud environments, employees, and corporate systems. The Director leads a cybersecurity manager and a team of security engineers and operations professionals, and partners closely with Cloud Engineering, Product Engineering, IT, and Compliance to reduce risk while enabling the company to build and operate securely.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the cybersecurity engineering and operations strategy with the VP, Compliance and Security, translating risk and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture standards, and measurable outcomes (e.g., remediation performance, control coverage, incident response effectiveness, attack surface and posture trends).
Lead the design and continuous improvement of security controls and guardrails across AWS and corporate environments, including cloud identity, network, workload, container/Kubernetes, and data protections, with security automation delivered as code (Terraform, Python, CI/CD, policy-as-code).
Own technical security operations and incident response: detection, investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery; maintain and exercise IR plans, playbooks, and runbooks; build automated detection and response workflows across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native tooling; and coordinate executive, legal, and regulatory escalation with the VP.
Own the vulnerability and exposure management program across applications, cloud, endpoints, and external attack surfaces, setting risk-based remediation SLAs and prioritizing by exploitability, exposure, and business impact while driving root-cause fixes for systemic weaknesses.
Provide security leadership for Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (MFA, Conditional Access, privileged identity management, Just-In-Time access), corporate endpoint and email security, and for application and product security across the SDLC, including SAST/DAST/SCA, SBOMs, API security, threat modeling, a security champions program, and AI-enabled applications and integrations.
Lead, mentor, and develop the cybersecurity manager, engineers, and security operations staff; define team structure, career paths, and operating processes that scale; manage security vendors, penetration testing, and managed security services; and serve as senior technical security advisor to Engineering, IT, Product, and executive leadership.

Required Skills

10+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including 5+ years in security leadership or management roles leading security engineering, security operations, or cloud security functions, with experience managing managers and technical teams.
Deep expertise securing cloud-native enterprise SaaS applications, with strong hands-on AWS security experience (IAM, VPC, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS/ECS, logging, monitoring) and strong knowledge of Linux, networking, containers, and Kubernetes.
Strong experience with security technologies including SIEM, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability management, WAF, and security monitoring platforms, and demonstrated experience building or improving incident detection and response programs.
Experience securing Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments (identity protection, MFA, Conditional Access, privileged identity management, access governance) and implementing privileged access management and Just-In-Time access architectures.
Strong understanding of application and API security (SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOMs, secrets management, authentication/authorization) and experience with security automation and scripting using Python, Bash, Terraform, APIs, and CI/CD platforms, including Infrastructure-as-Code security and policy-as-code guardrails.
Hands-on AI tool proficiency: experience using AI tools and LLM-based assistants in security work (e.g., AI-assisted alert triage, investigation, detection engineering, and automation), including crafting effective prompts, evaluating output accuracy, and integrating AI into security workflows. Experience securing AI-enabled applications, LLM integrations, and APIs is a plus.
Ability to communicate complex cybersecurity risks to engineering leaders, executives, and non-technical stakeholders, and to balance risk reduction with business objectives and engineering velocity.
Preferred: experience with multi-tenant SaaS security, CrowdStrike, Cloudflare (WAF and Zero Trust), DevSecOps, and offensive security or red-team programs; familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, or FedRAMP technical controls; and certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or GIAC.

$150,000 - $190,000 a year

At Onit, we’re committed to offering fair and competitive compensation. In addition to base pay, associates are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The final base salary you receive will reflect factors such as your skills, education, experience, and work location.

Benefits & Perks That Support You

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

Health Coverage Choices:
Three medical plan options, plus dental and vision, so you can choose what fits best. Employees on our HDHP plan also receive employer contribution to the HSA.

Retirement Savings:
401(k) with a 100% match on the first 3% and 50% on the next 2% of employee contributions.

Time Away:
Flexible paid time off, 7 sick days, and 9 paid company holidays annually.

Family Support:
Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.

Income Protection:
100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.

Additional Coverage Options:
Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident, and even pet insurance.

Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
Healthcare FSA, HSA, and dependent care FSA.

Community Engagement:
One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

Our Commitment to Applicants

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform
jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brokerage Platform
org is the backbone of everything Robinhood trades, clears, and settles. It is the underlying infrastructure that powers every equities trade, every options contract, every event contract, and every crypto transaction that moves through our platform — and it is the foundation on which Robinhood's most important business lines are built. The org spans four deeply interconnected teams: Market Data & Symbology (the real-time and reference data layer that the entire product experience depends on), Trading Platform (core order routing, execution management, and bulk order systems), Clearing (settlement, margin, security lending, cash sweep, and the full back-office operations stack), and Brokerage Infrastructure (the platform layer that enables every product team to move faster through abstractions, reliability investments, and next-generation stack modernization). This org operates 24 hours a day around critical market functions — from market open to trade settlement — and when things go wrong, it matters.

As the Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform
, you will lead one of Robinhood's largest and most consequential engineering organizations. You will own the technical strategy, people leadership, and delivery execution for a broad, high-stakes platform — partnering closely with a dedicated TPM and engaging deeply with trading, crypto, and active trader product teams who depend on your org every day. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will need the engineering depth to challenge technical bets, the platform mindset to drive the investments that move the business forward, and the leadership presence to build and retain a world-class team in a domain where the stakes are always high.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA
office, with in-person attendance expected 5
days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You’ll Do

Own the full engineering strategy and delivery for Brokerage Platform — spanning Market Data & Symbology, Trading Platform, Clearing, and Brokerage Infrastructure — setting the technical direction and ensuring the org executes with reliability and conviction
Lead and develop a large, distributed engineering organization of senior and staff-level engineers and engineering managers — building the talent, culture, and bench strength the org needs to sustain high performance over time
Drive platform investments that have direct business impact — identifying the modernization, reliability, and scalability bets worth making, building the conviction behind them, and seeing them through to measurable outcomes
Partner tightly with your TPM counterpart to manage a high volume of incoming asks from trading, crypto, active trader, and event contracts product teams — prioritizing ruthlessly and protecting engineering capacity for the work that matters most
Own the reliability and operational health of systems that run continuously around market-critical functions — ensuring the org is prepared for high-severity incidents and has the processes and tooling to resolve them fast
Engage deeply with cross-functional leadership across Robinhood — representing Brokerage Platform's roadmap, dependencies, and capabilities to product, ops, and executive stakeholders
Champion platform modernization and technical debt reduction — driving initiatives like stack rewrites, sharding, multi-region scaling, and infrastructure abstractions that unlock velocity across the entire engineering org

What You Bring

15+ years of software engineering experience, with 6+ years in engineering leadership roles — including demonstrated experience as a Director or Senior Director managing large, multi-team engineering organizations
Deep platform engineering background — you've owned and driven the technical direction of foundational backend platforms at scale, not just product features built on top of them
(big plus, though not directly required) Experience at the intersection of financial services, trading, brokerage, or adjacent high-criticality domains is a strong plus — you don't need to know all four of our sub-domains, but depth in one or two (market data, clearing, order execution, or brokerage infrastructure) is a meaningful signal
A track record of driving platform modernization bets that delivered real business outcomes — you've made the case for a large technical investment, executed it, and pointed to the result
Comfort operating in a high-severity, always-on engineering environment — you've led teams through major incidents and built the systems and culture to minimize their recurrence
Strong background with distributed systems, backend services at scale, Go or Python, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
Background from high-performance engineering organizations in fintech, trading, crypto, or large-scale consumer platforms — companies similar to Robinhood, Coinbase, SoFi, Google, or similar environments where the platform was the business is a strong plus!

Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.

Job Description

The Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) Operations & Automation Technology (OAT) Manager / Senior Manager serves as a technical leader supporting clinical cell therapy manufacturing operations. This role partners with Manufacturing, Facilities & Engineering, Quality, Validation, IT, Process Development, and Network MSAT to ensure reliable operation of manufacturing equipment, automation platforms, computerized systems, and data-integrity compliant processes.

The position provides technical support for GMP manufacturing, technology transfers, new product introductions, equipment lifecycle management, automation initiatives, deviation investigations, change controls, and continuous improvement projects. The engineer acts as a key interface between manufacturing operations and technology functions to drive operational excellence, scalability, and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Equipment and Automation Support

Provide technical support for GMP manufacturing equipment and automation systems.
Lead or support equipment troubleshooting, root-cause investigations, and implementation of corrective actions.
Support equipment upgrades, software updates, and introduction of new technologies.
Coordinate with Facilities & Engineering, Validation, IT, and vendors to maintain system reliability.
Serve as technical SME for assigned manufacturing systems and automation platforms.

Technology Transfer and New Product Introduction

Support clinical manufacturing technology transfers and process introductions.
Assess equipment readiness, automation requirements, and system impacts associated with new programs.
Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure successful implementation of manufacturing processes.
Develop and execute equipment-related readiness plans for new products and process changes.

Manufacturing Operations Support

Provide technical support during manufacturing campaigns.
Participate in lot monitoring, escalation management, and rapid issue resolution.
Evaluate process and equipment performance trends and identify improvement opportunities.
Support manufacturing readiness activities, batch execution success, and operational reliability.

Quality Systems and Compliance

Author and review deviations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, and technical reports.
Support impact assessments associated with equipment, automation, and process changes.
Ensure activities comply with GMP, data integrity, and regulatory requirements.
Support audit and inspection readiness activities.

Continuous Improvement and Data Analytics

Drive equipment and automation improvements that increase process robustness and operational efficiency.
Implement data collection, trending, monitoring, and visualization tools to improve manufacturing performance.
Evaluate emerging technologies, digital tools, AI solutions, and automation opportunities for clinical manufacturing.
Support development of dashboards and systems that improve operational visibility and decision making.

Success Measures

Reliable support of manufacturing operations with minimal equipment-related disruptions.
Timely execution of equipment upgrades and automation deployments.
Successful support of tech transfers and new product introductions.
High-quality investigation, CAPA, and change-control execution.
Implementation of technology and process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree and Eight Years' Experience

OR

Masters' Degree and Six Years' Experience

OR

PhD / PharmD

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in facilities, engineering in a biotech/pharma industry
Degree in Engineering, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or related field.
Experience supporting GMP manufacturing operations, automation systems, or process engineering.
Knowledge of biologics, cell therapy, gene therapy, or pharmaceutical manufacturing.
Experience with investigations, change controls, and quality systems.
Strong technical writing and cross-functional collaboration skills.
10+ years of relevant experience supporting cell therapy manufacturing operations.
Experience with MES, EBR, SCADA, PLC, data historians (OSI PI, Chronicle, CellFactory), or manufacturing automation systems.
Knowledge of qualification and validation requirements.
Experience leading technology transfers or equipment implementation projects.
Familiarity with computerized system lifecycle management and data integrity requirements.
Proficiency in application of AI-based solutions and data analytics in manufacturing environments.
Experience leading direct reports and developing and mentoring staff

People Leader Accountabilities

Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams.
Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose.
Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem

jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering and Analytics
jobs.description:
About Us

Greenbrook Medical is building the new standard in primary care.

We deliver high-touch, relationship-based care through neighborhood clinics, grounded in a simple belief: every senior deserves the kind of care we would want for our own families. Our model prioritizes time with patients, strong care coordination, and a personalized approach that improves outcomes while lowering total cost of care.

We take full accountability for patient outcomes and overall cost of care, aligning clinical excellence with disciplined execution. That commitment shows up in our results, including a patient Net Promoter Score of 90, compared to 32 for typical healthcare organizations.

Rooted in Tampa Bay and partnered with Tampa General Hospital, we are entering an exciting phase of growth. Backed by strong unit economics, experienced operators, and a proven playbook, we are looking for builders and operators who want to help scale a healthcare platform designed to deliver better care, better coordination, and better outcomes for seniors.

About The Role

We're hiring our first dedicated data leader. You'll build Greenbrook's foundational data layer and data intelligence capabilities. You’ll also build our data team and culture from the ground up.

This is a hands on role. You'll be in the code daily, own what's in production from day one, and build the roadmap from scratch, inclusive of data infrastructure and business logic. You will forecast needs out on the magnitude of quarters and build a team to support delivery.

Success in this role means end to end ownership, from data platform to metric delivery and data team performance. You report to the VP of Growth and Population Health and partner closely with our care teams to improve observability on our care model.

As Greenbrook’s Head of Data & Analytics, you own four things:

The analytics layer
: the dbt models and business logic that turn raw data into something usable, and the metric definitions underneath them
Reporting and BI
: the reporting layer the whole business reads from, and turning data into findings that our teams can react on to improve performance
Our production systems
: you take ownership of systems as they come in-house from our engineering partner, harden them, and keep making them better, with accountability for uptime & system integrity
The data roadmap and team development
: You will develop, in partnership with Greenbrook’s functional leaders, a data capabilities roadmap that supports the business. You will translate that roadmap into tactical goals and hiring plans to ensure that the data team is improving observability across all aspects of the business.

Location:
New York City strongly preferred (Hybrid). Open to exceptional remote candidates.

What You'll Do

Own the Analytics Layer

Build and maintain the dbt models and business logic behind our metrics and workflows in Google Cloud
Ensure metric definitions are consistent across every surface at Greenbrook
Build the reporting and dashboards the business uses to make decisions

Take Ownership of What's in Production

Take on systems as they move from our engineering partner into steady state, and keep improving them.
Catch ingestion, pipeline, and logic issues, and resolve them within our SLAs. Build monitoring and uptime reporting.
Be the counterpart our engineering partner hands production work to. Resolve what you can and escalate what needs them.

Make the Care Model Better With Data

Calculate and report on industry-standard care model measures
Turn quality and care-gap logic into triggers and flags inside our clinical workflows, so we act on data during the encounter, not after
Sit in the operating meetings where data gets used. Understand the care model well enough to define what we should measure and what good looks like
Surface patterns and risks proactively, acting as an early warning system for the business

Build the roadmap and the team

Own the end-to-end data roadmap, from data strategy to product delivery and integration. Construct roadmaps on the order of quarters that align with what the business needs
Build the data team from scratch. Put together a people roadmap, define sub-competencies based off of our needs, and design levels and competencies
Hire and manage data engineers and analysts. Start as a player coach and then hire to supplement skills and ensure delivery against the roadmap

What Success Looks Like

Data trust:
the business trusts the numbers, and you're ahead of issues rather than behind them
Impact:
data changes how we deliver care, and our quality measures improve year over year
Early warning:
leaders hear about emerging problems from you first
Coverage:
every metric our operating levers depend on has a certified definition and a single source of truth
Reliability:
systems transitioned to you stay healthy and get fixed fast when they break
Scale readiness:
new clinics come online with full data coverage from day one
Delivery:
committed quarterly work ships, and your counterparts, including performance managers and the Head of Population Health, rate the partnership highly

About You

You bring:

Strong SQL, dbt, and Python, and you still write production code
Hands-on experience with healthcare data, including claims, eligibility, and EHR data and familiarity with interoperability standards such as FHIR and HL7
Experience with value-based care measurement, such as HEDIS/Stars, HCC/RAF, and utilization
The ability to interpret data and explain what it means to clinical and business leaders in plain language
Experience owning production systems, including being the person who responds when something breaks
Experience building roadmaps, driving alignment on them, and hiring technical talent
A bachelor's degree
A mindset grounded in our core values of Heart, Excellence, Accountability, Resilience, and Teamwork

You'll stand out if you:

Have done this at a risk-bearing organization
, such as an ACO, MA plan, or at-risk provider, especially where data powered internal clinical software
Tie data to workflow:
you've moved a quality measure, not just reported on it
Challenge the status quo constructively:
you'll tell us what's not working and why
Get to root cause:
you find out why a number is wrong instead of patching the symptom
Enjoy both hardening what exists and building what's next

Are AI-native:
you use modern AI tools in your daily work
Drive outcomes:
you have a bias for action and close loops without being chased

Why You'll Love Working Here

Make An Impact Every Day

Be part of a mission-driven team transforming primary care for seniors. Your work directly supports better outcomes, better coordination, and better experiences for some of the most vulnerable patients in healthcare.

Work That Actually Matters

We're not a volume-driven system, we're accountable for outcomes. That means your work directly contributes to quality care, patient satisfaction, and meaningful improvements in how healthcare is delivered.

Build And Grow With Us

We're building more than a company, we're building careers. As we expand, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and take on new challenges.

Strong, Transparent Compensation & Benefits

Competitive base salary: Remote (U.S.): $160,000–$190,000; New York City: $175,000–$210,000
Generous annual performance bonus
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Paid time off
401(k) with company match

Our Selection Process

Application → Initial interview → Skills/experience interview → Values interview → Case Study and Case Study Interview → References

Equal Employment Opportunity and Commitment to Diversity

At Greenbrook Medical, we believe the only way we accomplish our mission is by building the best team in healthcare. We do this through a culture of respect and belonging, ensuring our teammates feel cared for first and foremost.

We will extend equal employment opportunity to all applicants without regard to age, race, ethnicity, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, socioeconomic background, disability status, military affiliation, pregnancy or any other status protected under federal, state and local laws. We encourage all who share our mission to apply. Greenbrook Medical will provide reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process. If you need additional accommodations or assistance, do not hesitate to contact our People team at recruiting@greenbrookmedical.com.

jobs.title: Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Infrastructure & Operations is responsible for leading the teams that support the company’s enterprise technology foundation, including infrastructure, network, cloud, data center, identity and access management, endpoint computing, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and infrastructure security and risk support.

This role supports a national, highly distributed environment across branch locations, manufacturing facilities, corporate offices, and data centers. The Senior Director will ensure critical technology services remain stable, secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with business needs.

The ideal candidate is an experienced infrastructure and operations leader who began their career in a hands-on technical role and progressed into senior leadership. This individual will partner closely with executives and technical teams, assess current operations, build practical roadmaps, improve service levels, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Application development, ERP systems, enterprise integrations, business intelligence, and software engineering are managed by a separate technology organization and are not part of this role.

Infrastructure & Operations Leadership

Set the strategic direction for enterprise infrastructure and operations, developing roadmaps that support business growth, scalability, security, and evolving business needs while evaluating current platforms, identifying gaps, prioritizing improvements, and establishing consistent operational standards, processes, and expectations.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on infrastructure decisions, investments, and risks, partnering with enterprise technology leadership to ensure infrastructure, identity, and endpoint platforms are prepared to support AI tools and services across the organization.
Participate in enterprise AI governance, evaluating the infrastructure, security, and data implications of new AI tools and technologies entering the environment.

IT Operations

Lead day-to-day enterprise infrastructure and support operations, creating consistency in incident, change, problem, and outage management while improving service quality, responsiveness, and the overall user experience.
Strengthen operational visibility through monitoring, reporting, and performance metrics, and partner with business leaders to understand challenges, remove technology obstacles, and improve service delivery.

Network, Cloud & Infrastructure Services

Oversee enterprise networking and telecommunications, including WAN, SD-WAN, LAN, wireless, internet connectivity, and related services, while leading hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure environments.
Lead infrastructure modernization through automation and platform improvements, while managing data center operations, backup platforms, recovery capabilities, infrastructure lifecycle planning, and initiatives designed to reduce operational risk through sound architecture, planning, and execution.

Identity, Security & Risk

Partner closely with cybersecurity leadership on infrastructure security initiatives, including identity and access management, vulnerability remediation, security incident response and recovery, compliance with internal security standards, and audit requirements.
Support the secure deployment and adoption of AI platforms by enforcing identity, access, and data protection standards across AI-enabled applications and services and assessing risks related to data handling, endpoint controls, and acceptable-use enforcement.

Establish and maintain Infrastructure and Service Desk KPIs, operational scorecards, and executive dashboards that provide visibility into infrastructure health, service performance, operational risk, customer satisfaction, and team productivity.
Track and report key metrics including infrastructure availability, SLA attainment, MTTR, MTTD, First Contact Resolution, change success rates, incident trends, vulnerability remediation, endpoint compliance, and customer satisfaction.
Present operational performance, trends, risks, and improvement plans to executive leadership, using data and measurable outcomes to identify improvement opportunities, strengthen accountability, and drive decisions based on business impact.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, develop, recruit, and retain a strong team of infrastructure and operations professionals, establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability while building future leaders.
Foster a culture of ownership, open communication, follow-through, and accountability across the organization.

Business Partnership & Vendor Management

Build strong relationships with executives, business leaders, and operational stakeholders, translating technical concepts into clear business terms and partnering effectively across the organization.
Manage technology vendors, service providers, and strategic partners while overseeing infrastructure budgets, technology-related operating expenses, contracts, and investments to maximize value and reduce risk.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field strongly preferred; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
12+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure and operations environments, including at least 5 years leading infrastructure, network, cloud, platform, or IT operations teams.
Prior experience reporting directly to a CIO, CTO, Executive Vice President, Senior Vice President, or equivalent executive technology leader.
Previous hands-on technical experience as a Systems Administrator, Infrastructure Engineer, Network Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Architect, or similar role.
Experience supporting organizations with at least 2,500 employees across multiple locations.
Experience leading hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise networking, cloud services, identity management, endpoint management, and infrastructure operations.
Experience leading Service Desk and end-user support organizations.
Experience managing technology vendors, service providers, contracts, budgets, and related operating expenses.
Experience developing and managing Infrastructure and Service Desk KPIs, operational scorecards, and executive dashboards.
Demonstrated experience presenting operational performance, risks, trends, and improvement plans to executive leadership.
Experience leading infrastructure and operations teams through growth, organizational change, acquisitions, transformation, or similar periods of significant change.
Strong communication skills and executive presence.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a related field.
Experience supporting highly distributed organizations, including manufacturing, distribution, retail, field services, or similar environments.
Experience supporting organizations with 3,000+ employees and 100+ locations.
Experience leading infrastructure modernization initiatives.
Infrastructure architecture or enterprise architecture experience.
ITIL certification or experience working within a similar operational framework.
Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CCNP, Azure, AWS, VMware, PMP, or ITIL.
Working knowledge of AI platform infrastructure requirements, including data security, licensing, and endpoint considerations.

About The Role And Team

Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Senior Engineering Manager (L6), whether you are leading a "team of teams" focused on hyper-personalizing the Uber Eats feed through cutting-edge ML, or overseeing the distributed compute platforms and payment systems that support millions of global earners, you are building for real-world impact at massive scale.

This role requires a leader who can navigate high-stakes ambiguity and make hard calls under pressure. You'll be responsible for setting long-term technical vision while managing the weight of decisions that affect global reliability and business outcomes. You won't just follow a playbook; you will help write it by building high-performing teams in an environment where the pace is relentless and the stakes are high. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and thrive in the "messy" reality of doing big things-this is where you'll make your mark.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organization of managers and staff-level ICs, fostering a culture of technical excellence, operational rigor, and continuous learning.
Define and execute the strategic roadmap for your domain, ensuring technical investments align with high-impact use cases and long-term business objectives.
Drive architectural decisions for large-scale distributed systems, challenging your teams to design robust, scalable solutions for batch compute, ML orchestration, or global payments.
Partner deeply across disciplines-including Product, Data Science, Design, and Finance-to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver seamless platform integrations.
Assume complete accountability for the reliability, cost-efficiency, and performance of your systems, establishing metrics that drive measurable impact.
Navigate a diverse set of opinions among global stakeholders, synthesizing different perspectives to drive decisions effectively and unblock execution.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering management and 4+ years as a manager of managers.
Proven track record of setting direction for an organization, constructing visions that unify multiple engineering teams and align with primary customer needs.
Demonstrated ability to drive high productivity and a bias to action across direct teams while proactively unblocking dependencies across the larger organization.
Experience coaching managers on crafting team visions and translating high-level strategy into actionable roadmaps and successful outcomes.
Expertise in managing organizational performance, making the hard calls when necessary, and building a reliable bench of the next generation of leaders.
Ability to drive a culture of high accountability for technical decisions, encouraging calculated risks and bets to balance long-term productivity with short-term needs.
Education: Master's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD in a technical field with a research or applied focus on large-scale ML systems, distributed computing, or related paradigms.
Domain expertise in Payments, AdTech, or Autonomous Systems, with an understanding of global and regional nuances.
Deep understanding of product experimentation, including the statistical mechanics and analysis needed to challenge experimental results.
Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas to C-level executives and non-technical audiences.
A "Driver" mindset: You are biased toward action, a master disambiguator, and stay resilient through constant change.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

jobs.title: Director, Software & Firmware Engineering
jobs.description:
Are you ready to build America’s energy future? Form Energy is an American manufacturing and energy technology company. We’re revolutionizing energy storage with cost-effective, multi-day technology designed to keep the electric grid secure and reliable, even during extended periods of stress. By strengthening the electric system and reimagining what’s possible, we’re giving clean energy a whole new form!

In recent years, Form Energy has earned a number of accolades, including being named by TIME as a “Best Invention”, MIT Technology Review as a “Top Climate Tech Company To Watch”, and Fast Company as “One of the Next Big Things In Tech”. We are making rapid progress on our mission of delivering energy storage for a better world, and our team is growing just as rapidly to meet demand. We have signed contracts with leading electric utilities across the United States and production of our iron-air batteries is underway at our first high-volume manufacturing facility in West Virginia.

Working for Form Energy is more than just a job, it’s a chance to be part of something extraordinary. And now - right as we significantly scale up battery manufacturing - might be the most exciting moment in the company’s history to join. We are assembling a team of highly talented and driven individuals across the country. Driven by our core values of humanity, excellence, and creativity, our team is determined to deliver on our mission and transform the energy landscape for the better.

Feeling energized to make a meaningful impact on the world? Then keep reading - you’ve come to the right place.

Role Description

Form Energy is seeking a Director of Software & Firmware Engineering to lead the organization responsible for the software and firmware that operate our energy storage products. Reporting to the Senior Director of Software Engineering & Test Engineering, this leader will oversee embedded software and firmware, the applications used to commission and service our products, and the engineering support required throughout development and the deployed lifecycle. You will bring together product software, firmware, lifecycle applications, and operational support into a cohesive engineering organization with clear ownership and strong technical discipline. This is an opportunity to shape the architecture, teams, and operating model behind a complex, software-enabled energy product with meaningful impact on the electric grid.

Relocation assistance is available.

What You'll Do

Lead and develop engineering managers, senior technical leaders, individual contributors, and contractors across embedded software, firmware, systems engineering, manufacturing software, and fleet operations.
Establish an integrated engineering strategy across requirements, architecture, reusable product platforms, firmware delivery, deployment, and operational support.
Drive a requirements-first and tooling-first approach to software development, safety, security, compliance, and technical evidence.
Build reusable software and firmware platforms spanning operating systems, middleware, networking, device runtime, simulation, build systems, release tooling, deployment interfaces, and secure OTA delivery mechanisms.
Lead the organization responsible for product firmware delivery, integration, debugging, release readiness, system bring-up, rapid prototyping, fixtures, and supporting engineering tools.
Oversee the production rollout and operation of deployed software, including fleet observability, production SRE, OTA execution, commissioning and service applications, incident response, and long-term fleet reliability.
Ensure commissioning, service, field, product, and test organizations receive effective software and firmware support throughout the product lifecycle.
Develop integrated staffing and execution plans, identify technical and organizational risks early, and drive clear prioritization decisions across competing product needs.
Partner closely with Product Management, hardware, controls, manufacturing, field operations, regulatory teams, Engineering Automation, and Product Quality.
Build a strong engineering culture centered on accountability, technical rigor, rapid learning, maintainability, modularity, reuse, and long-term fleet operability.

What You'll Bring

15+ years of experience in software, firmware, embedded systems, or product systems engineering, including significant experience leading managers and multidisciplinary engineering organizations.
Demonstrated success delivering complex software-enabled physical products through architecture, implementation, integration, verification, production, deployment, and field operation.
Strong technical depth in embedded software and firmware, operating systems, middleware, networking, distributed systems, and hardware/software interfaces.
Experience establishing requirements, systems architecture, technical governance, verification strategy, and engineering processes across multiple teams.
Proven ability to recruit, develop, and retain strong engineering managers and technical leaders while building clear organizational ownership and accountability.
Demonstrated ability to translate product priorities into staffing, investment, sequencing, and delivery decisions, make difficult tradeoffs, and communicate technical and organizational risks to executive and cross-functional audiences.

Humanity is a cornerstone of Form Energy’s culture, and we make sure our compensation and benefits reflect that. Form Energy offers competitive salaries, stock options, and a holistic benefits package to ensure all employees have what they need to thrive while working here.

When it comes to you and your family’s health, we cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees - and 80% of healthcare premiums for dependents. This starts from day one. We also offer at least 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents (up to 20 weeks for birthing parents), and generous vacation policies to give employees time to recharge when needed.

To build America’s energy future, we need everyone at the table. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply to our open jobs.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

At Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), we are building the next generation of cloud services that power mission-critical workloads for customers around the world. OCI combines the speed, ownership, and innovation of a startup with the scale, reliability, and customer focus of one of the world’s leading technology companies.

Oracle Managed Kubernetes (OMK) is Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's (OCI) enterprise-grade Kubernetes service that provides a managed, scalable, and secure environment to deploy containerized applications. It is built on the open-source Kubernetes engine and designed to simplify operations, improve performance, and provide deep integration with the broader OCI ecosystem.

We are seeking an experienced hands-on senior engineering manager to manage and grow a team of highly talented engineers responsible for designing, building, and operating software systems for OMK. You will own delivery, architecture, reliability, and operational health across multiple software areas while developing strong engineering leaders and technical talent.

The ideal candidate is an experienced engineering leader with a strong background in distributed systems, cloud services, operational platforms, and people leadership. You are comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-scale environments, driving technical strategy, building durable teams, and partnering across engineering, product, operations, and infrastructure organizations to deliver measurable business impact.

This is an opportunity to lead teams building software that directly improves how OCI supports global data center infrastructure, reduces operational friction, increases automation, and enables OCI to scale efficiently.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development:

Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams.
Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk.
Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions.

Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:

Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements.
Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project.
Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas.
Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:

Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:

Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions.
Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed.

Key Functions:

As a Senior Engineering Manager in Benchmark & Index Management, the individual will be responsible for leading globally distributed engineering teams delivering and operating business-critical technology platforms supporting index management and operational workflows.

The role combines engineering leadership, technical and architectural oversight, delivery accountability and people development. The candidate will work closely with Product, Operations, Index Delivery & Management, Architecture and Technology partners to deliver strategic capabilities, modernize existing platforms and continuously improve engineering quality, resilience and effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities:

Hands-on engineering leader who builds and scales globally distributed teams, driving the development of resilient, high-performance platforms that enable the end-to-end index lifecycle while partnering with Product and Operations to deliver commercial outcomes
Owns the end-to-end engineering delivery of scalable, resilient, secure and highly available technology solutions supporting index management and operational workflows
Provides technical and architectural direction for new capabilities, platform modernization and complex engineering decisions
Ensures solutions are designed and delivered in line with agreed engineering standards for maintainability, scalability, security, performance and operational resilience
Drives the modernisation of legacy platforms and adoption of cloud-native architecture where this provides clear business and technology benefit
Establishes and continuously improves engineering practices covering software design, coding standards, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, security and automation
Ensures appropriate testing and quality controls are embedded throughout the software delivery lifecycle
Guides teams in the effective design and implementation of APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, data processing solutions and enterprise integrations
Drives the responsible adoption of AI-assisted engineering, Generative AI, agentic AI and intelligent automation where these can improve engineering productivity, software quality, user experience or operational efficiency
Partners with Product Managers, Operations, Index Delivery & Management, Architecture, UX and other stakeholders to translate business priorities into pragmatic technology solutions and delivery plans
Balances strategic transformation and new capability delivery with the reliability, support and continued evolution of existing business-critical platforms
Communicates technical strategy, delivery progress, risks and complex engineering decisions clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences
Builds a high-performing engineering culture centered on ownership, accountability, collaboration, engineering excellence and continuous improvement
Mentors and develops engineers, technical leads and engineering managers, strengthening technical capability, leadership depth and succession across the organization

Experience & Skills:

15+ years of extensive proven experience in software engineering, including the design, development and operation of large-scale, business-critical applications in an enterprise environment
Proven experience leading and developing engineering teams responsible for complex technology products and platforms
Strong technical depth with the ability to provide credible architectural guidance and challenge engineering decisions constructively
Strong experience designing scalable, high-performance, data-intensive applications, data processing solutions and ETL/ELT pipelines
Strong knowledge of database modelling, design, performance tuning and optimization, with hands-on experience in relational database platforms such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL or similar, including SQL development and query optimization.
Strong software engineering experience with object-oriented programming languages such as C#, .NET, Java, Python or similar, including the design and implementation of APIs, distributed systems, and microservices architectures.
Experience delivering modern web applications using frameworks such as Angular, React, or comparable UI technologies, with a solid understanding of JavaScript, HTML, CSS and modern application design principles
Strong understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure and native services, including RDS, EC2, EKS/ECS, Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway and AWS Glue
Strong understanding of API design, microservices, event-driven architecture and enterprise integration patterns
Extensive experience with modern software engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, observability and automation
Strong understanding of software security, performance, scalability, resilience and production support considerations
Experience modernizing legacy applications and migrating or evolving platforms towards modern cloud-based architecture
Practical understanding of AI-assisted software engineering and intelligent automation, including appropriate security, governance and control considerations
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex business and technical requirements into pragmatic solutions
Experience working in agile delivery environments with a focus on collaboration, automation and continuous improvement
Experience working effectively across Product, Architecture, Business Analysis, Quality Assurance, Delivery Management and Technology Governance functions
Experience within Financial Markets, ideally Equities, Fixed Income, Index Management or related financial services technology
Experience with Java, including Spring Boot, and/or Python for integrations, greenfield development or legacy systems is advantageous
Familiarity with Sybase and PostgreSQL is advantageous
Experience with workflow orchestration or Business Process Management technologies such as IBM BAW or Camunda is advantageous

Key Attributes:

Strong engineering leader with the ability to set direction while remaining close enough to the technology to provide effective challenge and guidance
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders
Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivery, technology and operational outcomes
Demonstrated ability to mentor, develop and motivate engineers and engineering leaders
Excellent attention to detail combined with the ability to think strategically and solve complex business and technology problems
Able to prioritise effectively, make sound decisions and operate confidently in a complex and fast-moving environment
A passion for continuous learning, innovation and improving engineering practices
Collaborative, results driven, self-motivated and solutions oriented

jobs.title: Senior Manager of Software Engineering
jobs.description:
Description

Senior Manager of Software Engineering

Location:
Wallick Corporate Office – New Albany, OH

Job Type:
Full-time

Make a Difference—And Own Your Future

Join Wallick Communities, a 100% employee-owned company with over 55 years of experience in providing affordable housing and assisted living for families and seniors across the Midwest. With 1,000+ associates and a mission to open doors to homes, opportunity, and hope, we take pride in fostering a supportive and collaborative work environment where every employee-owner plays a vital role.

A Career with Wallick Means. . .

Creating Homes for People Who Need It Most: Providing new beginnings for residents seeking affordable, safe and high-quality housing where they can thrive.
Pay-on-Demand: access your money as you earn it.
Exceptional Benefit Package: Health, dental, vision insurance effective within 2 weeks of starting your new job, paid time off, gym membership reimbursement, paid parental leave, 401K, and more!
Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, including paid parental leave.
Learning & Support: A supportive team that cares about your continued development, well-being and professional growth.
Resident Stories That Stay with You: From Henry, who moved into his first-ever home, to Jaci, whose stay at a Wallick community allowed her to achieve homeownership and graduate college, kickstarting her dream career.
Work-Life Balance: Paid time off, including paid parental leave.
Career Growth: Tuition reimbursement, training, professional development, and advancement opportunities within a company that invests in its people.
Employee Owned, Resident Focused: As a 100% employee-owned company, your daily work (supporting our residents) also contributes to your financial future by sharing in our profitability.

What You’ll Do

The Sr Manager Software Engineering leads Build & Automate, Pillar 2 of Wallick's IT operating model, and holds accountability for every decision within it. The pillar owns the automation portfolio, the integration estate that moves operational data across Yardi, Dayforce, Procore, enterprise systems, and the satellite solutions that extend the systems of record, and it holds Wallick's AI agenda as a joint accountability with the Data & Analytics team. The pillar exists so that Wallick can grow without adding people at the same rate: it automates repetitive work, connects the systems so data moves without being rekeyed, and gives business teams controlled tools for configuration and workflow instead of unrestricted direct admin access to the core systems. You will report to the VP of Information Technology and work together with other team members and leaders.
The seat is deliberately a business-technology leader, not a Principal Architect. The role owns outcomes, priorities, and the pillar's accountability. Deep technical authority lives with the Principal Software Engineer — Integrate & Aggregate, the Sr. manager's trusted technical advisor on architecture and engineering calls. The Leader consults the Principal before committing externally, then decides. Both know the seams, and the model works because they are honest.

What We’re Looking For

Bachelor's degree in business, information systems, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
A track record, typically built over eight or more years, in delivering business technology solutions, including at least three years leading a technical team or a portfolio of technical work.
Business acumen and stakeholder engagement: able to represent the pillar at the executive table, negotiate priorities with business leaders, and explain a technical trade-off in business terms.
Portfolio and priority judgment: experience running a backlog of integration, automation, and software work against business outcomes, and holding the line on scope.
Growing technical breadth rather than depth: working literacy in integration patterns, workflow automation, AI and agent tooling, and modern application platforms, with the appetite to keep learning and the comfort to decide with strong technical input from a peer whose judgment you trust.
AI and automation strategic literacy, exercised jointly with the Data & Analytics team: able to see where automation and AI change an operating process and where they do not, and to reach those judgments with a peer rather than alone.
Governance experience: solution architecture approval, change and release management, and application portfolio decisions (rationalization, sunset, and portfolio health).
People leadership: developing engineers at different career stages, including a principal-level advisor and an early-career builder.
Familiarity with the Microsoft cloud ecosystem (Microsoft 365, Azure, Power Platform, Copilot Studio) is strongly preferred. Experience in multifamily housing, senior living, or another regulated operating business is a plus.

Functions And Responsibilities

Pillar Leadership and Portfolio Management

Lead the Build & Automate pillar and its portfolio of integration, automation, AI, and software engineering initiatives, aligned with business roadmaps.
Provide leadership and career development for the Principal Software Engineer, Integrate & Aggregate, and the Software Engineer, Extend.
Partner with the Principal Software Engineer on architecture and technical strategy, leveraging the role’s technical expertise before making external commitments.
Represent the pillar with IT leadership and business stakeholders, coordinating cross-pillar priorities with the Leaders of Business Capabilities and IT Operations & Trust.

Integration, Automation, and AI

Own the strategy, priorities, health, and outcomes of enterprise integrations, including data movement across Yardi, Dayforce, Procore, and other systems, as well as modernization of legacy integrations.
Oversee the integrations and pipelines that deliver operational data to the Data & Analytics platform, in coordination with business data owners, Data & Analytics, and Power & Protect.
Jointly lead the automation and AI portfolio with Data & Analytics, including prioritization, governance, delivery, and measurement of business value.
Co-chair the AI Council, which governs AI policy, platforms, licensing, data access, investment priorities, and value measurement. Escalate unresolved decisions to the SVP of Organizational Effectiveness and Technology.
Move validated concepts from experimentation into scalable, supported enterprise solutions.

Architecture, Governance, and Applications

Own solution architecture for the pillar, with the Principal Software Engineer developing technical patterns and standards for leadership review and approval.
Oversee change and release governance for pillar solutions.
Manage the application portfolio, including the application register, portfolio health, rationalization, and retirement decisions. Commercial license management remains with the Vendor Management Analyst.
Chair the weekly cross-pillar technical council to coordinate standards, dependencies, and technical decisions.

Transformation Program Leadership

Serve as the default leader for major cross-pillar transformation programs with a significant technology build component, subject to assignment by the VP of Information Technology.
Deliver programs with clear scope, priorities, dependencies, and sequencing.
Partner with Partner & Transform from program inception to incorporate stakeholder engagement, change management, and adoption into delivery plans.

Wallick’s Mission & Values

At Wallick Communities, We Believe In Opening Doors To Homes, Opportunity, And Hope For Our Residents, Associates, And Community. Our Core Values Guide Everything We Do

Care – We show compassion and respect for everyone.
Character – We do the right thing, even when no one is looking.
Collaboration – We work together to achieve more.

At Wallick, we celebrate Diversity, Equity, Inclusion + Belonging (DEI+B) in our workplace and communities, creating an environment where associates feel welcome, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to the great work they do every day.

For nearly 60 years, it has been at the core of our organization’s culture that all Wallick associates come to a safe and inclusive place to work. Wallick does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), political affiliation, military service, or other non-merit-based factors.

Join Us and Become an Employee-Owner!

If you're ready to make a difference in people’s lives while securing your financial future, apply today!

We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. Join our company and be part of a team that uses the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.

Within Small Molecule Science & Technology (SM S&T), we are advancing digital and data capabilities that strengthen technical operations, accelerate insight generation, and improve business outcomes across the product lifecycle. The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics is a newly created and exciting role, and we are looking for a data-minded engineer to join Small Molecule Science and Technology (SMS&T) to lead and build a data engineering and analytics team across Technical Operations.

The Director of Data Engineering and Analytics, reporting to the Executive Director or End to End Technical Leadership Organization, will serve as the technical leader responsible for translating Small Molecule Science & Technology's (SM S&T) data and analytics priorities into execution, adoption, and business value. This role requires who can drive accountability and execution across a highly matrixed organization across SM S&T, Digital Manufacturing Division, Digital CMC, MPI, IT and Global Pharmaceutical Operations to accelerate the deployment, implementation and standardization of digital strategy tools to advance analytics and data engineering capabilities, deliver sustained adoption and measurable business impact.

The Director is expected to bring a strong understating of digital systems and tools, data science and analytics operating effectively at the intersection of business, science, manufacturing, engineering, and digital technology. The role requires a strong technical understanding of unit operations across Small Molecule Drug Substance, Drug Product, Packaging, and Analytical Sciences to maximize value add to the pipeline and inline portfolio.

Responsibilities

Drive execution of agreed-upon data and analytics priorities across Small Molecule Science & Technology (SM S&T), ensuring progress and measurable business impact.
Translate data and analytics strategy into practical implementation plans, clear milestones, and value realization metrics.

Drive adoption of capabilities that support Proactive Process Monitoring, Continuous Process Verification, Manufacturing Process Intelligence (MPI), and data-driven decision-making.
