new_jobs.title: Director of Data Engineering and Analytics
new_jobs.description:
Job Description

We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. Join our company and be part of a team that uses the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.

Within Small Molecule Science & Technology (SM S&T), we are advancing digital and data capabilities that strengthen technical operations, accelerate insight generation, and improve business outcomes across the product lifecycle. The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics is a newly created and exciting role, and we are looking for a data-minded engineer to join Small Molecule Science and Technology (SMS&T) to lead and build a data engineering and analytics team across Technical Operations.

The Director of Data Engineering and Analytics, reporting to the Executive Director or End to End Technical Leadership Organization, will serve as the technical leader responsible for translating Small Molecule Science & Technology's (SM S&T) data and analytics priorities into execution, adoption, and business value. This role requires who can drive accountability and execution across a highly matrixed organization across SM S&T, Digital Manufacturing Division, Digital CMC, MPI, IT and Global Pharmaceutical Operations to accelerate the deployment, implementation and standardization of digital strategy tools to advance analytics and data engineering capabilities, deliver sustained adoption and measurable business impact.

The Director is expected to bring a strong understating of digital systems and tools, data science and analytics operating effectively at the intersection of business, science, manufacturing, engineering, and digital technology. The role requires a strong technical understanding of unit operations across Small Molecule Drug Substance, Drug Product, Packaging, and Analytical Sciences to maximize value add to the pipeline and inline portfolio.

Responsibilities

Drive execution of agreed-upon data and analytics priorities across Small Molecule Science & Technology (SM S&T), ensuring progress and measurable business impact.
Translate data and analytics strategy into practical implementation plans, clear milestones, and value realization metrics.
Partner with SM S&T leadership, Digital Manufacturing Division, Digital CMC, MPI, IT, and site teams to align priorities and remove barriers to execution.
Ensure analytics initiatives are anchored in clear business problems and deliver practical value to the organization.
Serve as a credible translator between technical SMEs, manufacturing teams, and data/IT partners.
Convert complex business and manufacturing needs into practical analytical requirements and scalable solution designs.
Influence the data and analytics strategy across partner organizations where alignment is required.
Advance the democratization and engineering of data across SM S&T by improving the access, contextualization, and usability of manufacturing and process data.
Lead data engineering initiatives to build robust data pipelines, ensuring data quality and accessibility from source systems to analytical platforms.
Enable scientists and engineers to directly access and use data to support process monitoring, investigations, and lifecycle management.
Drive adoption of capabilities that support Proactive Process Monitoring, Continuous Process Verification, Manufacturing Process Intelligence (MPI), and data-driven decision-making.
Lead the implementation and adoption of data and analytics solutions across SM S&T.
Apply a strong technical understanding of unit operations across Drug Substance, Drug Product, Packaging, and analytical to ensure analytical tools are effectively utilized across the portfolio.
Establish and strengthen user communities to scale adoption beyond centralized expertise.
Represent SM S&T business priorities in data governance, portfolio, and demand management forums.
Partner with leadership to define the highest-value use cases and ensure resources are focused on impactful priorities.
Track progress against priorities and hold teams accountable for delivery, adoption, and value realization.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor of Science (BS) in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Data Science, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline with ten (10) years of required experience. (MS with 8)
Demonstrated leadership in pharmaceutical manufacturing, technical operations, data engineering, or data science, with a proven track record of driving data-driven transformation in a regulated environment.
Deep understanding of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes, including a strong technical understanding of unit operations across Drug Substance, Drug Product, packaging, and analytical.
Expertise in manufacturing data systems, process monitoring, and data and analytics technologies supporting technical operations.
Proven ability to influence across matrix organizations and drive accountability for execution and results.
Travel to Manufacturing site will be required, estimated at

Preferred

Advanced degree (MS, MBA, PharmD, or PhD).
Experience with manufacturing data and analytics platforms such as DataLynx, SEEQ, MPI, MES, historians, or similar technologies.

Required Skills

Advanced Analytics, Advanced Analytics, Business Alignment, Business Intelligence (BI), Database Administration, Data Engineering, Data Integrity, Data Management, Data Modeling, Data Visualization, Design Applications, Digital Transformation, Executive Leadership, Implementation Methodologies, Information Management, Metrics Development, Process Alignment, Process Definition, Progress Monitoring, Software Development, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Solution Architecture, Strategic Alignment, Strategy Deployment, System Designs {+ 1 more}

new_jobs.description:
Your work days are brighter here.

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

About The Team

The Client Platform team, part of Business Technology (BT) at Workday, is responsible for managing, securing, and optimizing every end-user device across our global workforce. We build the digital foundation that enables employees to work securely and seamlessly from anywhere. Managing a hybrid ecosystem of macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android devices, our team sits at the vital intersection of endpoint management, enterprise security, and employee experience.

About The Role

We are looking for a dynamic, high-ownership Director of Client Platforms to lead our global endpoint engineering and management organization. Operating with a high sense of urgency, you will drive the strategy, lifecycle, and security posture for thousands of endpoints. You are a decisive leader who excels at cross-functional partnership - working hand-in-hand with Information Security to enforce zero-trust policies, maintain patching cadences, and leverage AI to automate device provisioning, L2 ticket resolution, and fleet compliance.

Responsibilities

Strategic Fleet Management: Define and execute the global hardware, OS, and endpoint management strategy across Apple (macOS/iOS) and PC/Android ecosystems to ensure a premium employee experience without compromising security.
Security & Vulnerability Partnership: Work in lockstep with the Information Security team to establish, measure, and enforce robust endpoint security baselines, zero-trust access controls, disk encryption, and rapid patching/vulnerability remediation.
AI & Operational Automation: Leverage AI capabilities and automated workflows to accelerate device onboarding/offboarding, streamline configuration enforcement, and drive intelligent ticket deflection for endpoint-related L2/L3 issues.
Global Team Leadership: Direct, develop, and scale a high-performing team of endpoint engineers, architects, and platform leads operating across time zones.
Tooling Architecture & Optimization: Own and optimize our core platform stack, including Jamf Pro, Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, and zero-touch deployment pipelines (Apple Business Manager, Autopilot).
Vendor & Lifecycle Management: Drive global hardware procurement strategies, manage OEM relationships (Apple, Dell, Lenovo), oversee hardware refresh cycles, and manage software licensing costs to maximize ROI.

About You

Obsessed with Execution: You possess a relentless drive and bias for action. When vulnerability disclosures occur, you act with high urgency to ensure quick compliance and fleet-wide protection.
Collaborative Partner: You view Security as a core partner. You know how to balance rigorous security compliance with a smooth user experience. You build strong relationships across other BT functions and business organizations.
Forward-Thinking Innovator: You stay ahead of modern device management trends and actively use AI and scripting automation to remove operational friction and human error.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of enterprise IT leadership experience, with at least 4+ years leading global teams focused on client platform engineering, endpoint management, or desktop infrastructure.
4+ years of experience managing diverse fleet architectures at scale (25,000+ endpoints across macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android).
5+ years of experience with enterprise MDM/UEM platforms, specifically Jamf Pro and Microsoft Intune.

Other Qualifications

Demonstrated track record of partnering with Security teams to meet SLAs on OS/application patching, EDR deployments, and compliance reporting.
AI domain fluency, including a practical understanding of modern AI capabilities, limitations, governance considerations, and responsible enterprise application.
Demonstrated experience managing multi-million-dollar IT software budgets and leading complex enterprise vendor negotiations.
Experience operating within high-growth Bay Area technology companies.
Expertise in zero-touch deployment models (Apple Business Manager/DEP, Windows Autopilot) and identity integrations (Okta, Entra ID).
Strong familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO 27001, HIPAA) and EDR platforms (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne).

Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). new_jobs.description:

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Slack is looking for an Engineering Manager on the Core Services engineering team. The purpose of this role is to keep Slack working seamlessly at massive scale — it's the infrastructure that keeps Slack feeling lightning fast. This person will be a steward of some of the most critical, high-throughput systems at Slack — the kind of work where doing it well means millions of users, at the world’s most important and interesting companies, never experience a hiccup.

About The Opportunity

We operate at tremendous scale with systems that process millions of events per second. Our team maintains and builds performant services that include:

Edge Caches
Realtime Services
Enterprise Key Management (EKM)
International Data Residency (IDR)
Image Uploads, Downloads, and Proxying

We've done our job correctly when none of our users think about us, much like a vital utility. We don't typically ship new user-facing features, but rather ensure our systems are exceptionally performant, highly available, reliable, and scalable. In other words, we make Slack work seamlessly. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).

We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.

We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If

You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If

You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.
You've led teams through system deprecation and migration while maintaining service reliability.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

In the United States, compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, job level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, and benefits. Slack's backend services are written in Go and Java, and Slack's API is built on PHP/Hack.

The Core Services Team

We are a team building critical services that enable Slack to scale for our largest customers. Our edge caches power the most latency-critical queries for our largest entities today, serving approximately 35% of all Slack API traffic. Our Realtime Services (RTS) power Slack's core messaging stack — running 10 services, 4 of which are mission-critical Tier 0 services — ensuring that messages, presence, and real-time events are delivered reliably at scale. We also own services that power Slack's Enterprise Key Management and International Data Residency features, enabling Slack to win and retain enterprise and government customers with strict compliance requirements (FedRAMP/NIST).

We have a strong commitment to quality and understand that simplicity and reliability are the foundations of our work.

We are actively building the future of edge services at Slack, so we can support a growing number of globally distributed customers with their compliance requirements with minimal latency.

What You'll Be Doing

Owning the technical direction and roadmap across the Core Services portfolio: Edge Caches, Realtime Services, Enterprise Key Management, International Data Residency, and Image Proxying and Uploads. You’ll have large footprint and the opportunity to drive major impact. And you'll decide what to invest in now, what to sequence later, and what to decline — balancing reliability, migration, and new capability work.
Leading a multi-system migration of Flannel to Loom, our next-generation edge cache, while keeping the current systems running at full reliability for millions of users. You'll drive the team to ship new capabilities without introducing risk to infrastructure that people depend on daily.
Driving delivery and execution while maintaining reliability as a top priority, including sprint planning, product launches, incident follow-ups, operational sustainability analyses, and building the technical case for investment with leadership. You'll ensure the team doesn't trade reliability for velocity, but is always high-performing.
Owning on-call operations and incident management for Tier 0 services. You'll manage on-call rotations across partnering teams, triage production issues, lead incident response for your services, and drive improvements to runbooks, alerting, and operational tooling.
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, AWS, and other infrastructure teams on dependencies, timelines, and risks. You'll be the shortest path to solutions — whether it's unblocking a compliance audit for South Korea, coordinating IDR region launches with Sales and AWS, or negotiating priorities with partner teams for shared work.
Representing your team's work in leadership reviews, quarterly and annual planning, and executive forums. You'll build compelling business-and-technical cases for your team's investments and tell your leadership what's really going on early enough that nothing becomes a fire drill.
Building and maintaining a high-trust team culture where engineers do impactful work and grow. You'll hire well, manage performance with fairness and transparency, mentor emerging technical leaders, and celebrate your team's wins.
Managing cost and capacity for services that run at massive scale, working with finance on AWS spend trends, exec-approved budget increases, and cost-saving initiatives like the Loom migration (projected $1-2M savings).
Driving the team to adopt AI development tooling for maximum impact, while maintaining engineering rigor and quality for critical infrastructure.

You're Our Person If

You've led engineering teams for 5+ years building and operating high-scale, high-availability backend infrastructure or distributed systems.
You have strong software engineering fundamentals with previous experience as a Senior+ backend engineer, with enough depth to be credible in architecture discussions about caching, distributed systems, observability and reliability best practices, and system design — and to build SME knowledge in a new area fast.
You have a history of managing Tier 0 / Tier 1 services where uptime matters deeply, including owning on-call rotations, leading incident response, and driving operational improvements.
You have experience with realtime messaging systems or event-driven architectures at scale — presence, message delivery, pub/sub, or similar systems where latency and reliability directly impact user experience.
You have experience leading multi-quarter migration or platform evolution projects while simultaneously keeping existing systems reliable.
You've managed teams through prioritization trade-offs — weighing reliability vs. feature work vs. cost vs. compliance — and can articulate those decisions to both engineers and executives.
You have experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders (Product, Sales, Compliance, Security, Infrastructure) to turn business requirements into engineering plans.
You understand how to build a high-performing team culture: hiring, performance management, retention of top performers, and growing new technical leaders.
You have experience managing engineers across multiple time zones, with an async rhythm that doesn't depend on overlap hours.
An understanding of how and where AI software development tooling can be deployed for maximum team impact.

Even Better If

You have experience with the Go and/or Java programming language at scale.
Experience with AWS infrastructure, including multi-region architectures.
Experience with Kubernetes and container-based deployments.
Experience working within highly regulated environments where an understanding of FedRAMP/NIST frameworks was essential.
Experience with Enterprise Key Management, data residency, or compliance-driven infrastructure.
You've managed teams responsible for Edge Caching, CDN, or API gateway systems.
You've led teams through system deprecation and migration while maintaining service reliability.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Please review the following job description:

The Senior Director, Agentic Engineering serves as the executive leader of Forge's agentic engineering organization and is accountable for the technical vision, engineering execution, and operational excellence behind Truist's enterprise AI agent ecosystem. This leader owns the engineering function responsible for designing, building, deploying, and operating production-grade AI agents, multi-agent systems, and agentic workflows that transform how teammates and clients interact with the Firm.

This is a highly technical player-coach leadership role that combines executive organizational leadership with deep hands-on engineering expertise. The Senior Director leads the engineering function, establishes technical direction, drives work planning and execution, and serves as the ultimate escalation point for architecture and engineering decisions across the agentic engineering portfolio.

The successful candidate will bring extensive experience building large-scale software and AI systems, including expertise in Python, modern systems languages such as Go, agentic frameworks, LLM orchestration, retrieval architectures, and enterprise AI platform engineering. This leader will be responsible for shipping production agentic systems, not simply defining roadmaps, ensuring all solutions meet Truist standards for security, scalability, resiliency, observability, governance, and regulatory compliance.

The Senior Director partners closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Risk, and executive leadership teams to translate business strategy into enterprise-scale AI capabilities while building and mentoring a world-class team of agentic engineers.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

Lead the Agentic Engineering function, providing executive leadership, organizational design, technical governance, delivery accountability, and talent leadership across all agentic engineering initiatives.
Own the technical direction for Forge agentic solutions, establishing architecture standards, engineering patterns, and development practices for enterprise AI agents and multi-agent systems.
Drive work planning, prioritization, execution management, and delivery outcomes across the agentic engineering organization, ensuring teams consistently deliver high-quality production systems aligned to business commitments.
Serve as the final engineering authority for architecture decisions, engineering standards, and critical code review escalations across the agentic engineering portfolio.
Design and govern enterprise patterns for agent orchestration, tool invocation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory management, prompt architecture, workflow automation, reasoning frameworks, evaluation pipelines, observability, and operational support.
Lead the engineering strategy for enterprise agent platforms including Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and other emerging agentic technologies required to support the Forge roadmap.
Partner with Product, Technology, Security, Risk, Architecture, and Data leaders to ensure AI solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned to enterprise priorities.
Build and mentor a high-performing engineering organization through hiring, performance management, succession planning, coaching, career development, and technical leadership.
Establish and enforce engineering excellence standards including software craftsmanship, testing strategies, release management, architecture review, secure development practices, operational readiness, and reliability engineering.
Drive engineering execution across complex cross-functional initiatives involving application engineering, platform engineering, data engineering, AI engineering, cyber security, and enterprise architecture teams.
Champion engineering rigor through measurable quality controls, system reliability objectives, operational metrics, and continuous improvement practices.
Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, models, and engineering approaches, identifying opportunities to accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and strengthen enterprise capabilities
Represent Agentic Engineering in executive governance forums, architecture review boards, risk committees, vendor engagements, regulatory discussions, and industry working groups.
Manage organizational budgets, vendor relationships, workforce planning, engineering tooling investments, and resource allocation to support strategic objectives.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, engineering excellence, continuous learning, and responsible AI development across the organization

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent education, training and work-related experience.
Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience in technology operations.
Broad leadership and management experience leading complex technology operations teams.
Proven ability to manage complex operational initiatives across multiple teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leading enterprise Agentic Engineering, AI Platform Engineering, Applied AI, Intelligent Automation, or Emerging Technology organizations.
Deep expertise in multi-agent systems, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt engineering, reasoning architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory systems, agent evaluation, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Experience building production AI applications using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Agent Engine, or similar platforms.
Experience operating enterprise-scale AI platforms supporting thousands of users and mission-critical business processes.
Strong understanding of AI governance, model risk management, responsible AI principles, AI security controls, and enterprise AI operating models.
Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, mentor senior engineers and engineering leaders, and build a culture of technical excellence.
Experience delivering solutions across cloud-native ecosystems using Azure and modern DevOps, platform engineering, and software delivery practices.
Experience driving architecture modernization and transformation initiatives within large enterprises.
Experience in financial services, fintech, cybersecurity, or other heavily regulated industries.
Demonstrated participation in industry forums, technology communities, open-source initiatives, vendor partnerships, or executive technology councils.

The annual base salary for this position is $240,000 - $360,000

About The Job

As the Director of Security Software Engineering, you will build and scale a critical engineering organization at the forefront of securing modern cloud software ecosystems. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

new_jobs.title: Systems Director - Space-Based Interceptor Ground Segment Engineering
new_jobs.description:
The Aerospace Corporation is the trusted partner to the nation’s space programs, solving the hardest problems and providing unmatched technical expertise. As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Defense Systems Group (DSG) provides analysis-based decision support to senior leaders on space architectures, policy and strategy, technology development, warfighter capability enablers, systems integration, defense industrial base, and threat reduction to help shape existing and future space missions across the national security space (NSS) enterprise. DSG is unique at Aerospace as it not only directly supports major customers, including the U.S. Space Force, U.S. Space Command, Air Force Material Command, and senior leadership at the Pentagon, but also provides a broad range of technical support across the national space enterprise, maintaining vertical responsibilities with customers’ portfolios as well as horizontal, matrixed responsibilities across the corporation. Additionally, DSG provides deep technical expertise to the Space Force Space Systems Command (SSC) in the conception, design, acquisition, launch and operations of satellite, launch vehicle, ground control, and range systems.

The Special Programs Division supports a broad array of Combat Power missions covering the entire threat response chain which includes the multidomain effects needed for space superiority. These programs include major system acquisitions for multiple ground and space segments, future architecture definition at the data/software/hardware levels, and research and technology for continuous evolution of space warfighting capabilities. The Space-Based Interceptor (SBI) Program Office seeks to develop and deploy a proliferated constellation of space-based interceptors capable of boost-phase engagement of adversary missiles. The SBI interceptors will employ multiple common elements that integrate with a larger layered missile defense system.

We are looking for a Systems Director - Space-Based Interceptor Ground Segment Engineering
to lead the SBI Ground Segment team that directly advises the government SBI Program Office on the development of the space segment of this novel missile defense capability.

The selected candidate will be required to work full-time, on-site at our facility in Huntsville, AL.

What You’ll Be Doing

Building and leading a dynamic team that provides technical expertise to the government Space-Based Interceptor Program Office (SBI PO) ground segment
Exemplify Aerospace corporate values of objectivity and integrity when serving as a trusted agent to the Material Leader of the SBI ground segment and senior government customers
Enabling direct reports to lead efforts to bring impactful technical expertise to the government and industry from SMEs across the corporation
Collaborating effectively with the broader layered defense architecture team and external stakeholders
Establishing a collaborative work environment that fosters a culture of innovation within the team to facilitate novel acquisition approaches for rapid capability development
Defining the Space Segment’s objectives and communicating them to subordinates, management, and interfacing matrix organizations to ensure alignment, clarity, and coordinated efforts towards achieving strategic goals and successful program execution.

What You Need To Be Successful

Minimum Requirements for Systems Director – Engineering Program Management and Systems Engineering:

Bachelor's degree in a STEM field or equivalent technical area of study
12 or more years of relevant professional or educational experience
Strong interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills for interactions at all levels of corporate and government leadership
Proven leadership ability to operate strategically, including leading teams contributing to strategic objectives
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across organizations and manage competing priorities
Track record of delivering results through effective delegation while holding oneself accountable for results
This position requires a current and active Top Secret/SCI security clearance, which is issued by the U.S. government. U.S citizenship is required to obtain a security clearance

How You Can Stand Out

It would be impressive if you have one or more of these :

Demonstrated experience in space systems engineering, missile defense technologies, and/or satellite operations
Proven track record of creating and leading multidisciplinary teams in high-stakes environments
Demonstration of excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with government agencies, industry partners, and contractors are necessary for maintaining strong relationships and ensuring alignment among all parties
Demonstrates enterprise-level perspective with prior Program Office(s) and ETG experience
Knowledge of rigorous testing and evaluation processes, including on-orbit demonstrations and live-fire tests
Experience with novel approaches in rapid capability development and deployment
Demonstrated management skills including budgeting, staff development, and strategic planning
Knowledge of Aerospace practices and policies relevant to department leadership

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. The grade-based pay range for this job is listed below. Individual salaries within that range are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge and skills.

(Min - Max)

$168,200.00 - $252,400.00

Pay Basis: Annual

Leadership Competencies

Our leadership philosophy is simple: every employee, regardless of level and role, can demonstrate leadership. At Aerospace, our commitment is our people. To cultivate our talent and ensure that we have a strong pipeline of future leaders, we want individuals who:

Operate Strategically
Lead Change  
Engage with Impact  
Foster Innovation  
Deliver Results

Ways We Reward Our Employees

During your interview process, our team will provide details of our industry-leading benefits.

Benefits vary and are applicable based on Job Type. A few highlights include:

Comprehensive health care and wellness plans
Paid holidays, sick time, and vacation
Standard and alternate work schedules, including telework options
401(k) Plan — Employees receive a total company-paid benefit of 8%, 10%, or 12% of eligible compensation based on years of service and matching contributions; employees are immediately eligible and vested in the plan upon hire
Flexible spending accounts
Variable pay program for exceptional contributions
Relocation assistance
Professional growth and development programs to help advance your career
Education assistance programs
An inclusive work environment built on teamwork, flexibility, and respect

We are all unique, from various backgrounds and all walks of life, yet one thing bonds all of us to each other—the belief that we can make a difference. This core belief empowers us to do our best work at The Aerospace Corporation.

Equal Opportunity Commitment

The Aerospace Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, color, religion, genetic information, marital status, ancestry, national origin, protected veteran status, physical disability, medical condition, mental disability, or disability status and any other characteristic protected by state or federal law. If you’re an individual with a disability or a disabled veteran who needs assistance using our online job search and application tools or need reasonable accommodation to complete the job application process, please contact us by phone at 310.336.5432 or by email at peoplemangmnt.mailbox@aero.org . You can also review Know Your Rights: Workplace Discrimination is Illegal.

new_jobs.description:
About Onit

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using AI at the core
to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

Onit is seeking a Director of Cybersecurity Engineering & Operations to lead the technical cybersecurity function across our AI-driven legal operations SaaS platforms and corporate infrastructure. Reporting to the Vice President, Compliance and Security, this highly technical leader translates the organization's cybersecurity strategy into security architecture, engineering capabilities, and security operations that protect our products, cloud environments, employees, and corporate systems. The Director leads a cybersecurity manager and a team of security engineers and operations professionals, and partners closely with Cloud Engineering, Product Engineering, IT, and Compliance to reduce risk while enabling the company to build and operate securely.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the cybersecurity engineering and operations strategy with the VP, Compliance and Security, translating risk and business priorities into technical roadmaps, architecture standards, and measurable outcomes (e.g., remediation performance, control coverage, incident response effectiveness, attack surface and posture trends).
Lead the design and continuous improvement of security controls and guardrails across AWS and corporate environments, including cloud identity, network, workload, container/Kubernetes, and data protections, with security automation delivered as code (Terraform, Python, CI/CD, policy-as-code).
Own technical security operations and incident response: detection, investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery; maintain and exercise IR plans, playbooks, and runbooks; build automated detection and response workflows across SIEM, SOAR, EDR, and cloud-native tooling; and coordinate executive, legal, and regulatory escalation with the VP.
Own the vulnerability and exposure management program across applications, cloud, endpoints, and external attack surfaces, setting risk-based remediation SLAs and prioritizing by exploitability, exposure, and business impact while driving root-cause fixes for systemic weaknesses.
Provide security leadership for Microsoft 365 and Entra ID (MFA, Conditional Access, privileged identity management, Just-In-Time access), corporate endpoint and email security, and for application and product security across the SDLC, including SAST/DAST/SCA, SBOMs, API security, threat modeling, a security champions program, and AI-enabled applications and integrations.
Lead, mentor, and develop the cybersecurity manager, engineers, and security operations staff; define team structure, career paths, and operating processes that scale; manage security vendors, penetration testing, and managed security services; and serve as senior technical security advisor to Engineering, IT, Product, and executive leadership.

Required Skills

10+ years of progressive cybersecurity experience, including 5+ years in security leadership or management roles leading security engineering, security operations, or cloud security functions, with experience managing managers and technical teams.
Deep expertise securing cloud-native enterprise SaaS applications, with strong hands-on AWS security experience (IAM, VPC, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS/ECS, logging, monitoring) and strong knowledge of Linux, networking, containers, and Kubernetes.
Strong experience with security technologies including SIEM, EDR, CSPM, vulnerability management, WAF, and security monitoring platforms, and demonstrated experience building or improving incident detection and response programs.
Experience securing Microsoft 365 and Entra ID environments (identity protection, MFA, Conditional Access, privileged identity management, access governance) and implementing privileged access management and Just-In-Time access architectures.
Strong understanding of application and API security (SAST, DAST, SCA, SBOMs, secrets management, authentication/authorization) and experience with security automation and scripting using Python, Bash, Terraform, APIs, and CI/CD platforms, including Infrastructure-as-Code security and policy-as-code guardrails.
Hands-on AI tool proficiency: experience using AI tools and LLM-based assistants in security work (e.g., AI-assisted alert triage, investigation, detection engineering, and automation), including crafting effective prompts, evaluating output accuracy, and integrating AI into security workflows. Experience securing AI-enabled applications, LLM integrations, and APIs is a plus.
Ability to communicate complex cybersecurity risks to engineering leaders, executives, and non-technical stakeholders, and to balance risk reduction with business objectives and engineering velocity.
Preferred: experience with multi-tenant SaaS security, CrowdStrike, Cloudflare (WAF and Zero Trust), DevSecOps, and offensive security or red-team programs; familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, or FedRAMP technical controls; and certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, AWS Security Specialty, or GIAC.

$150,000 - $190,000 a year

At Onit, we’re committed to offering fair and competitive compensation. In addition to base pay, associates are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. The final base salary you receive will reflect factors such as your skills, education, experience, and work location.

100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.

Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident, and even pet insurance.

Tax-Advantaged Accounts:
Healthcare FSA, HSA, and dependent care FSA.

Community Engagement:
One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

new_jobs.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Brokerage Platform
org is the backbone of everything Robinhood trades, clears, and settles. It is the underlying infrastructure that powers every equities trade, every options contract, every event contract, and every crypto transaction that moves through our platform — and it is the foundation on which Robinhood's most important business lines are built. The org spans four deeply interconnected teams: Market Data & Symbology (the real-time and reference data layer that the entire product experience depends on), Trading Platform (core order routing, execution management, and bulk order systems), Clearing (settlement, margin, security lending, cash sweep, and the full back-office operations stack), and Brokerage Infrastructure (the platform layer that enables every product team to move faster through abstractions, reliability investments, and next-generation stack modernization). This org operates 24 hours a day around critical market functions — from market open to trade settlement — and when things go wrong, it matters.

As the Director of Engineering, Brokerage Platform
, you will lead one of Robinhood's largest and most consequential engineering organizations. You will own the technical strategy, people leadership, and delivery execution for a broad, high-stakes platform — partnering closely with a dedicated TPM and engaging deeply with trading, crypto, and active trader product teams who depend on your org every day. This is not a role for someone who manages from a distance. You will need the engineering depth to challenge technical bets, the platform mindset to drive the investments that move the business forward, and the leadership presence to build and retain a world-class team in a domain where the stakes are always high.

This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA
office, with in-person attendance expected 5
days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What You’ll Do

Own the full engineering strategy and delivery for Brokerage Platform — spanning Market Data & Symbology, Trading Platform, Clearing, and Brokerage Infrastructure — setting the technical direction and ensuring the org executes with reliability and conviction
Lead and develop a large, distributed engineering organization of senior and staff-level engineers and engineering managers — building the talent, culture, and bench strength the org needs to sustain high performance over time
Drive platform investments that have direct business impact — identifying the modernization, reliability, and scalability bets worth making, building the conviction behind them, and seeing them through to measurable outcomes
Partner tightly with your TPM counterpart to manage a high volume of incoming asks from trading, crypto, active trader, and event contracts product teams — prioritizing ruthlessly and protecting engineering capacity for the work that matters most
Own the reliability and operational health of systems that run continuously around market-critical functions — ensuring the org is prepared for high-severity incidents and has the processes and tooling to resolve them fast
Engage deeply with cross-functional leadership across Robinhood — representing Brokerage Platform's roadmap, dependencies, and capabilities to product, ops, and executive stakeholders
Champion platform modernization and technical debt reduction — driving initiatives like stack rewrites, sharding, multi-region scaling, and infrastructure abstractions that unlock velocity across the entire engineering org

What You Bring

15+ years of software engineering experience, with 6+ years in engineering leadership roles — including demonstrated experience as a Director or Senior Director managing large, multi-team engineering organizations
Deep platform engineering background — you've owned and driven the technical direction of foundational backend platforms at scale, not just product features built on top of them
(big plus, though not directly required) Experience at the intersection of financial services, trading, brokerage, or adjacent high-criticality domains is a strong plus — you don't need to know all four of our sub-domains, but depth in one or two (market data, clearing, order execution, or brokerage infrastructure) is a meaningful signal
A track record of driving platform modernization bets that delivered real business outcomes — you've made the case for a large technical investment, executed it, and pointed to the result
Comfort operating in a high-severity, always-on engineering environment — you've led teams through major incidents and built the systems and culture to minimize their recurrence
Strong background with distributed systems, backend services at scale, Go or Python, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)
Background from high-performance engineering organizations in fintech, trading, crypto, or large-scale consumer platforms — companies similar to Robinhood, Coinbase, SoFi, Google, or similar environments where the platform was the business is a strong plus!

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them:

Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What We Offer

Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

Reliable support of manufacturing operations with minimal equipment-related disruptions.

Successful support of tech transfers and new product introductions.
High-quality investigation, CAPA, and change-control execution.
Implementation of technology and process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

Knowledge of biologics, cell therapy, gene therapy, or pharmaceutical manufacturing.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Infrastructure & Operations
new_jobs.description:
Great Day Improvements - Senior Director, Infrastructure & Operations

Job-type
Full-Time, exempt.

Location
On-site role based out of Twinsburg, OH; Cincinnati, OH; or Somerset, NJ. Candidates must currently live within a commutable distance of one of these locations or be willing to relocate.

Salary Range
$160,000 - $180,000 base compensation. This range represents a good faith estimate of the expected base salary for this position. Final base salary will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and alignment with market data.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Infrastructure & Operations is responsible for leading the teams that support the company’s enterprise technology foundation, including infrastructure, network, cloud, data center, identity and access management, endpoint computing, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and infrastructure security and risk support.

This role supports a national, highly distributed environment across branch locations, manufacturing facilities, corporate offices, and data centers. The Senior Director will ensure critical technology services remain stable, secure, scalable, resilient, and aligned with business needs.

The ideal candidate is an experienced infrastructure and operations leader who began their career in a hands-on technical role and progressed into senior leadership. This individual will partner closely with executives and technical teams, assess current operations, build practical roadmaps, improve service levels, develop talent, strengthen accountability, and drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Application development, ERP systems, enterprise integrations, business intelligence, and software engineering are managed by a separate technology organization and are not part of this role.

Infrastructure & Operations Leadership

Set the strategic direction for enterprise infrastructure and operations, developing roadmaps that support business growth, scalability, security, and evolving business needs while evaluating current platforms, identifying gaps, prioritizing improvements, and establishing consistent operational standards, processes, and expectations.
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on infrastructure decisions, investments, and risks, partnering with enterprise technology leadership to ensure infrastructure, identity, and endpoint platforms are prepared to support AI tools and services across the organization.
Participate in enterprise AI governance, evaluating the infrastructure, security, and data implications of new AI tools and technologies entering the environment.

IT Operations

Lead day-to-day enterprise infrastructure and support operations, creating consistency in incident, change, problem, and outage management while improving service quality, responsiveness, and the overall user experience.
Strengthen operational visibility through monitoring, reporting, and performance metrics, and partner with business leaders to understand challenges, remove technology obstacles, and improve service delivery.

Network, Cloud & Infrastructure Services

Oversee enterprise networking and telecommunications, including WAN, SD-WAN, LAN, wireless, internet connectivity, and related services, while leading hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure environments.
Lead infrastructure modernization through automation and platform improvements, while managing data center operations, backup platforms, recovery capabilities, infrastructure lifecycle planning, and initiatives designed to reduce operational risk through sound architecture, planning, and execution.

Identity, Security & Risk

Partner closely with cybersecurity leadership on infrastructure security initiatives, including identity and access management, vulnerability remediation, security incident response and recovery, compliance with internal security standards, and audit requirements.
Support the secure deployment and adoption of AI platforms by enforcing identity, access, and data protection standards across AI-enabled applications and services and assessing risks related to data handling, endpoint controls, and acceptable-use enforcement.

Operational Metrics & Performance Management

Establish and maintain Infrastructure and Service Desk KPIs, operational scorecards, and executive dashboards that provide visibility into infrastructure health, service performance, operational risk, customer satisfaction, and team productivity.
Track and report key metrics including infrastructure availability, SLA attainment, MTTR, MTTD, First Contact Resolution, change success rates, incident trends, vulnerability remediation, endpoint compliance, and customer satisfaction.
Present operational performance, trends, risks, and improvement plans to executive leadership, using data and measurable outcomes to identify improvement opportunities, strengthen accountability, and drive decisions based on business impact.

Team Leadership

Lead, coach, develop, recruit, and retain a strong team of infrastructure and operations professionals, establishing clear priorities, expectations, and accountability while building future leaders.
Foster a culture of ownership, open communication, follow-through, and accountability across the organization.

Business Partnership & Vendor Management

Build strong relationships with executives, business leaders, and operational stakeholders, translating technical concepts into clear business terms and partnering effectively across the organization.
Manage technology vendors, service providers, and strategic partners while overseeing infrastructure budgets, technology-related operating expenses, contracts, and investments to maximize value and reduce risk.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field strongly preferred; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered.
12+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure and operations environments, including at least 5 years leading infrastructure, network, cloud, platform, or IT operations teams.
Prior experience reporting directly to a CIO, CTO, Executive Vice President, Senior Vice President, or equivalent executive technology leader.
Previous hands-on technical experience as a Systems Administrator, Infrastructure Engineer, Network Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Architect, or similar role.
Experience supporting organizations with at least 2,500 employees across multiple locations.
Experience leading hybrid cloud and on-premise infrastructure environments, with strong knowledge of enterprise networking, cloud services, identity management, endpoint management, and infrastructure operations.
Experience leading Service Desk and end-user support organizations.
Experience managing technology vendors, service providers, contracts, budgets, and related operating expenses.
Experience developing and managing Infrastructure and Service Desk KPIs, operational scorecards, and executive dashboards.
Demonstrated experience presenting operational performance, risks, trends, and improvement plans to executive leadership.
Experience leading infrastructure and operations teams through growth, organizational change, acquisitions, transformation, or similar periods of significant change.
Strong communication skills and executive presence.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in a related field.
Experience supporting highly distributed organizations, including manufacturing, distribution, retail, field services, or similar environments.
Experience supporting organizations with 3,000+ employees and 100+ locations.
Experience leading infrastructure modernization initiatives.
Infrastructure architecture or enterprise architecture experience.
ITIL certification or experience working within a similar operational framework.
Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CCNP, Azure, AWS, VMware, PMP, or ITIL.
Working knowledge of AI platform infrastructure requirements, including data security, licensing, and endpoint considerations.

new_jobs.description:
Cleaned Document

About The Role And Team

Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. As a Senior Engineering Manager (L6), whether you are leading a "team of teams" focused on hyper-personalizing the Uber Eats feed through cutting-edge ML, or overseeing the distributed compute platforms and payment systems that support millions of global earners, you are building for real-world impact at massive scale.

This role requires a leader who can navigate high-stakes ambiguity and make hard calls under pressure. You'll be responsible for setting long-term technical vision while managing the weight of decisions that affect global reliability and business outcomes. You won't just follow a playbook; you will help write it by building high-performing teams in an environment where the pace is relentless and the stakes are high. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and thrive in the "messy" reality of doing big things-this is where you'll make your mark.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow a high-performing engineering organization of managers and staff-level ICs, fostering a culture of technical excellence, operational rigor, and continuous learning.
Define and execute the strategic roadmap for your domain, ensuring technical investments align with high-impact use cases and long-term business objectives.
Drive architectural decisions for large-scale distributed systems, challenging your teams to design robust, scalable solutions for batch compute, ML orchestration, or global payments.
Partner deeply across disciplines-including Product, Data Science, Design, and Finance-to identify opportunities, prioritize initiatives, and deliver seamless platform integrations.
Assume complete accountability for the reliability, cost-efficiency, and performance of your systems, establishing metrics that drive measurable impact.
Navigate a diverse set of opinions among global stakeholders, synthesizing different perspectives to drive decisions effectively and unblock execution.

Basic Qualifications

10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years in engineering management and 4+ years as a manager of managers.
Proven track record of setting direction for an organization, constructing visions that unify multiple engineering teams and align with primary customer needs.
Demonstrated ability to drive high productivity and a bias to action across direct teams while proactively unblocking dependencies across the larger organization.
Experience coaching managers on crafting team visions and translating high-level strategy into actionable roadmaps and successful outcomes.
Expertise in managing organizational performance, making the hard calls when necessary, and building a reliable bench of the next generation of leaders.
Ability to drive a culture of high accountability for technical decisions, encouraging calculated risks and bets to balance long-term productivity with short-term needs.
Education: Master's degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD in a technical field with a research or applied focus on large-scale ML systems, distributed computing, or related paradigms.
Domain expertise in Payments, AdTech, or Autonomous Systems, with an understanding of global and regional nuances.
Deep understanding of product experimentation, including the statistical mechanics and analysis needed to challenge experimental results.
Strong storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas to C-level executives and non-technical audiences.
A "Driver" mindset: You are biased toward action, a master disambiguator, and stay resilient through constant change.

For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year - USD $297,000 per year.

For Seattle, WA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year - USD $297,000 per year.

For Sunnyvale, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $267,000 per year - USD $297,000 per year.

For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.

Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook - it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves - we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
